words.en: If you produce something, you make or create it.

words.tr:
adj. 大规模的；大量的；
n. 大量；质量；块；群；团；
words.ex: The company launched a mass production line to meet demand.
words.ex_cn: 该公司启动了大规模生产线以满足需求。
words.en: A mass is a large amount of something that has no particular shape or arrangement.

words.ex: The merchants sell fruit at the market.
words.ex_cn: 商人们在市场卖水果。
words.en: Merchants are people who buy and sell goods, especially in large amounts.

words.tr: n. 脱落；脱落的部分；（尤指）剪下的布料边角；（体育比赛中）失误；（计算机）错误；（口语）失败者；（俚语）退场；（非正式）休息
words.ex: He made an offs during the soccer game.
words.ex_cn: 他在足球比赛中出现了失误。
words.en: A colloquial abbreviation for 'offspring', referring to children or young animals.

words.tr: n. 定价； v. “price”的现在分词；
words.ex: The pricing of the new phone is very fair.
words.ex_cn: 这部新手机的定价非常合理。
words.en: The process of deciding how much to charge for a product or service.

words.tr: n. 鸟笼; 鸟笼状的东西; 类似鸟笼的场所（如牢房等）
words.ex: The bird lives in a small birdcage.
words.ex_cn: 鸟住在一个小鸟笼里。
words.en: A birdcage is a structure of wire or bars in which birds are kept.

words.ex: The dog has a flea on its back.
words.ex_cn: 狗的背上有一只跳蚤。
words.en: A flea is a very small jumping insect that has no wings and feeds on the blood of humans or animals.

words.ex: The witch stirred the potions carefully.
words.ex_cn: 女巫小心地搅拌着药水。
words.en: A potion is a liquid that is believed to have magical, healing, or poisonous properties.

words.ex: He tried to loosen the tight screw.
words.ex_cn: 他试图拧松那颗紧的螺丝。
words.en: If you loosen something or if it loosens, it becomes less tight, less firmly fixed, or less strongly attached.

words.ex: He took opium for pain relief.
words.ex_cn: 他服用鸦片来缓解疼痛。
words.en: Opium is a powerful drug made from the juice of the opium poppy, which is used to relieve pain or to help people sleep.

words.tr: n. 风；“wind”的复数； v. 蜿蜒；
words.ex: The winds blew strongly last night.
words.ex_cn: 昨晚风刮得很猛烈。
words.en: n. The movement of air, especially when it is strong enough to be felt or to move things; v. To twist or turn something around itself or something else.

words.ex: The lab has a new apparatus for measuring temperature.
words.ex_cn: 实验室有一台新的温度测量装置。
words.en: The complex structure of a particular system or organization, or the equipment used for a specific purpose.

words.ex: The aforementioned rules apply to all students.
words.ex_cn: 前述的规则适用于所有学生。
words.en: Used to refer to something that has already been mentioned.

words.tr: n. 杂种；私生子；卑鄙的人（复数形式）
words.ex: Those bastards stole my bike.
words.ex_cn: 那些混蛋偷了我的自行车。
words.en: A contemptuous term for people who are considered unpleasant or despicable.

words.ex: In days of yore, the knights would ride out to protect the kingdom.
words.ex_cn: 在往昔的日子里，骑士们会骑马出去保护王国。
words.en: time long past

words.tr: n. 不久以前；去年; adv. 过去不久的岁月
words.ex: The fashion of yesteryear is making a comeback.
words.ex_cn: 去年流行的时尚正在卷土重来。
words.en: Yesteryear refers to the previous year or the past in general, often evoking a sense of nostalgia.

words.tr: n. 平地，平原（plain 的复数）
words.ex: The cows graze on the plains.
words.ex_cn: 牛在平原上吃草。
words.en: A large area of flat land with few trees.

words.tr: n. 撒哈拉沙漠（非洲北部一大沙漠）
words.ex: The Sahara is a very big desert in Africa.
words.ex_cn: 撒哈拉是非洲的一个非常大的沙漠。
words.en: The Sahara is the largest hot desert in the world, covering most of North Africa.

words.ex: The garden has ornamental flowers.
words.ex_cn: 这个花园里有装饰性的花卉。
words.en: Something that is ornamental is intended to be attractive and is not necessary or useful.

words.ex: She has periods every month.
words.ex_cn: 她每个月都有经期。
words.en: A period is a length of time during which something happens or exists.

words.ex: Water causes erosion of the soil.
words.ex_cn: 水会导致土壤腐蚀。
words.en: The process by which the surface of the earth is worn away by the action of water, glaciers, winds, waves, etc.

words.tr:
n. 破坏（建筑物等）的行为
v. 破坏；“wreck”的现在分词
words.ex: The wrecking of the ship was caused by a severe storm.
words.ex_cn: 这艘船的失事是由一场猛烈的风暴引起的。
words.en: The act of destroying or severely damaging something, especially a ship or building.

words.ex: The apothecary mixed herbs to help the sick.
words.ex_cn: 药剂师混合草药来帮助病人。
words.en: An apothecary is a person who prepares and sells medicines and drugs.

words.ex: He sent the message via email.
words.ex_cn: 他通过电子邮件发送了这条消息。
words.en: If you go somewhere via a particular place, you go through that place on the way to your destination.

words.ex: His pursuit of happiness made him work hard every day.
words.ex_cn: 他对幸福的追求让他每天努力工作。
words.en: The act of pursuing something or someone, especially in order to catch or achieve them.

words.tr: adv. 冷淡地；不在乎地；淡然地
words.ex: He answered the question indifferently.
words.ex_cn: 他漠然地回答了那个问题。
words.en: In a manner that shows a lack of interest, concern, or sympathy; without enthusiasm or preference.

words.ex: We have sufficient food for the trip.
words.ex_cn: 我们有足够的食物用于这次旅行。
words.en: If something is sufficient for a particular purpose, there is enough of it for the purpose.

words.tr: adj. 经过排练的；背诵过的；做过的
words.ex: He rehearsed his speech before the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议前排练了他的演讲。
words.en: Practiced or performed in advance to improve skill or fluency.

words.ex: The child recites the poem every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子每天早上背诵这首诗。
words.en: To repeat aloud or declaim (a poem or passage) from memory before an audience.

words.ex: The teacher's question prompts students to think harder.
words.ex_cn: 老师的问题促使学生更深入地思考。
words.en: If you prompt someone to do something, you cause them to do it. A prompt is a sign or a message that tells you to do something.

words.tr: v. 察觉；“perceive”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He perceived a change in her voice.
words.ex_cn: 他察觉到她的声音有了变化。
words.en: If you perceive something, you see, notice, or realize it, especially when it is not obvious.

words.ex: He is merely a student.
words.ex_cn: 他仅仅是个学生。
words.en: You use merely to emphasize that something is only what you say and not better, more important, or more exciting.

words.ex: The doctor wrote new prescriptions for her medicine.
words.ex_cn: 医生为她开了新的处方。
words.en: A prescription is a written order, especially by a physician, for the preparation and administration of a medicine or other treatment.

words.ex: He emphasizes the importance of homework.
words.ex_cn: 他强调作业的重要性。
words.en: To give special importance or prominence to (something) in speaking or writing.

words.tr: v. 重复；“repeat”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 重复的；反复发生的；
words.ex: He repeated the words after the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他跟着老师重复了这些话。
words.en: Something that is repeated happens or is done more than once.

words.tr:
n. 文件；公文；文献；
v. 记录；为…提供证明；
words.ex: He submitted the document to the office.
words.ex_cn: 他把文件提交给了办公室。
words.en: A document is a piece of text or graphics, for example a letter, that is stored as a file on a computer and that you can access in order to read it or change it.

words.ex: She is flexible with her schedule.
words.ex_cn: 她的日程安排很灵活。
words.en: Able to change or be changed easily according to the situation.

words.tr: v. 给…上色，着色( dye的过去式和过去分词 ); 能染上颜色
words.ex: She dyed her hair blue last week.
words.ex_cn: 她上周把头发染成了蓝色。
words.en: Dyed refers to something that has been colored by a dye.

words.ex: They bought luxuries like silk clothes and gold watches.
words.ex_cn: 他们买了丝绸衣服和金表这样的奢侈品。
words.en: Luxuries are things that are not necessary but which give you pleasure or make your life more comfortable.

words.tr: n. 营业额；人员流动率；周转率；
words.ex: The store's turnover increased last month.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店上个月的营业额增加了。
words.en: The amount of money taken by a business in a particular period.

words.ex: The movie recreates the battle of Waterloo.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影再现了滑铁卢战役。
words.en: To recreate something means to make it exist or happen again, or to make a copy of something that existed in the past.

words.ex: The cost of maintenance is low for this car.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车的维持费用很低。
words.en: The process of preserving a condition or situation or the state of being preserved.

words.tr: v. 使遭受（痛苦、伤害等）
words.ex: He is inflicting pain on himself.
words.ex_cn: 他正在给自己造成痛苦。
words.en: To cause something unpleasant or harmful to be suffered by someone or something.

words.tr: n. 赞助人；资助人；老主顾
words.ex: The patron gave money to support the art exhibition.
words.ex_cn: 赞助人捐钱支持了这场艺术展览。
words.en: A patron is a person who supports with money, gifts, efforts, or endorsement an artist, musician, writer, form of art, or charitable cause.

words.tr: n. [计]打印；报刊，印刷品；图片，相片；印花布；印花布（print 的复数）；
words.ex: The printer has many prints on the table.
words.ex_cn: 打印机在桌子上有很多打印件。
words.en: To produce books, newspapers, magazines, etc., by a mechanical process involving the transfer of text or designs to paper.

words.ex: He went on an errand to buy milk.
words.ex_cn: 他去买牛奶了。
words.en: An errand is a short journey that you make in order to do a job for someone, for example when you go to a shop to buy something for them.

words.ex: His wisdom helped the team solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他的智慧帮助团队解决了问题。
words.en: Wisdom is the ability to use your knowledge and experience to make good decisions and judgments.

words.tr: n. 易被劝服的人；容易做的事情
words.ex: He was a pushover in the negotiations, easily agreeing to all their demands.
words.ex_cn: 他在谈判中是个容易对付的人，轻易同意了他们所有的要求。
words.en: A pushover is someone who is easily defeated or influenced.

words.tr: adj, 易碎成小薄片的；易剥落的；古怪的；不可靠的
words.ex: The pastry was flaky and delicious.
words.ex_cn: 这糕点薄而易剥落，非常美味。
words.en: If something is flaky, it means it is made of or easily breaks into small, thin pieces. It can also describe someone who is unreliable or eccentric.

words.tr: adj. 户外的，适用于户外（活动者）的，爱好野外活动的
words.ex: He is an outdoorsy person who loves hiking.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个热爱徒步的户外爱好者。
words.en: Enjoying or connected with outdoor activities and life in the countryside.

words.ex: The king summoned the knight to the castle.
words.ex_cn: 国王召见骑士到城堡。
words.en: To summon means to call upon someone or something to come or appear, often in a formal or authoritative manner.

words.ex: He wants to study journalism after high school.
words.ex_cn: 他想在高中后学习新闻工作。
words.en: The profession or practice of reporting about, photographing, or editing news stories for one of the mass media.

words.ex: The barracuda swims fast in the ocean.
words.ex_cn: 梭鱼在海洋中游得很快。
words.en: A large, predatory marine fish with a long, slender body, sharp teeth, and a reputation for being aggressive and fast, often found in tropical and subtropical waters.

words.tr: n. 黏糊糊的东西；污垢
words.ex: After the spill, there was gunk all over the kitchen floor.
words.ex_cn: n. 黏糊糊的东西；污垢
words.en: Gunk refers to a sticky or messy substance, often dirt or filth.

words.tr: v. 跛行；蹒跚而行（hobble 的现在分词形式）
words.ex: The old man was hobbling down the street.
words.ex_cn: 那位老人正一瘸一拐地走在街上。
words.en: Walking in a slow, unsteady way, typically because of injury or weakness.

words.ex: The streetlight is on at night.
words.ex_cn: 路灯在晚上是亮着的。
words.en: A streetlight is a light on a tall post in the street, which provides light so that people can see when it is dark.

words.ex: Water and oil are fluids.
words.ex_cn: 水和油是液体。
words.en: Fluids are substances that flow and take the shape of their container. This includes both liquids and gases.

words.ex: He is a faker who pretends to be a doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他是个冒牌货，假装自己是医生。
words.en: A faker is someone who pretends to be something they are not or who makes counterfeit copies of something.

words.ex: She smiled seductively at him across the room.
words.ex_cn: 她隔着房间对他迷人地微笑。
words.en: In a manner that is attractive and tempting, often in a sexual way.

words.tr: adj. 滴水的；潮湿的；多愁善感的
words.ex: The weather was so drippy that we had to cancel our picnic.
words.ex_cn: 天气太潮湿了，我们不得不取消野餐。
words.en: Something that is drippy is wet in a way that is not pleasant, or it is overly sentimental.

words.tr: v. 蒸发；汽化；使变成蒸汽
words.ex: The water is vaporizing in the sun.
words.ex_cn: 水正在阳光下蒸发。
words.en: Turning into vapor or steam, or destroying something completely.

words.ex: The teacher will distribute the books to students.
words.ex_cn: 老师将把书分发给学生。
words.en: If you distribute things, you hand them or deliver them to a number of people.

words.tr:
adj. 经授权的；经认可的
v. 授权；委托；批准；“authorize”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: He is an authorized dealer for this brand.
words.ex_cn: 他是这个品牌的授权经销商。
words.en: Officially allowed or approved.

words.tr: adj. 书本上的；好读书的；书呆子气的
words.ex: He is too bookish and doesn't know real life.
words.ex_cn: 他太书本气了，不懂现实生活。
words.en: Someone who is bookish spends a lot of time reading serious books and is more interested in ideas than in people or activities.

words.tr: v. 记住；“memorize”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: He memorized the multiplication table last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚记住了乘法表。
words.en: To learn something so that you remember it exactly.

words.tr:
n. 价值；（数）值；
v. 估价；重视；
words.ex: The value of this painting is very high.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画的价值很高。
words.en: If you value something or someone, you think that they are important and you appreciate them.

words.ex: He showed courtesy by holding the door open.
words.ex_cn: 他为别人扶着门，表现得很礼貌。
words.en: Courtesy is polite behavior, or a polite action or remark.

words.tr: adj. 拥挤的；堵塞的； v. “congest” 的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The road was congested with cars during rush hour.
words.ex_cn: 高峰时段，这条路被汽车挤满了。
words.en: If a place is congested, it is extremely crowded and blocked with traffic or people.

words.tr: v. 打喷嚏；“sneeze”的现在分词
words.ex: He is sneezing because of the dust.
words.ex_cn: 他因为灰尘在打喷嚏。
words.en: Sneezing is an involuntary expulsion of air from the nose and mouth caused by irritation of the nostrils.

words.ex: He stayed home because he had the flu.
words.ex_cn: 他因为得了流感待在家里。
words.en: The flu is an infectious disease characterized by fever, aches and pains, and respiratory symptoms.

words.tr: n. 软弱的人或动物( weakling的名词复数 )
words.ex: The coach encouraged the weaklings to build their strength through regular exercise.
words.ex_cn: 教练鼓励那些软弱的人通过定期锻炼来增强力量。
words.en: Weaklings are people or animals that are not physically strong.

words.tr: n. 三色堇（pansy的复数形式）；娇弱的人（贬义）
words.ex: She planted pansies in her garden.
words.ex_cn: 她在花园里种了三色堇。
words.en: A derogatory term for people considered weak or effeminate.

words.tr:
n. 火花；火星；
v. 激发；
words.ex: The match produced a small spark.
words.ex_cn: 火柴产生了一个小火花。
words.en: A spark is a small fiery particle thrown off from a fire, alight in ashes, or produced by striking together two hard surfaces such as stone or metal.

words.tr: n. [园艺] 三色堇；同性恋男子；三色紫罗兰; vt. 打扮; vi. 打扮; adj. 女性化的...
words.ex: The garden has many colorful pansy flowers.
words.ex_cn: 花园里有许多五颜六色的三色堇花。
words.en: A pansy is a small garden plant with brightly colored flowers, or a term used to describe a man who is considered weak or effeminate.

words.ex: He told the story about incest in the old family.
words.ex_cn: 他讲了那个关于家族乱伦的旧事。
words.en: Incest is sexual activity between family members or close relatives.

words.tr: v. 游行；列队行进；炫耀；展示
words.ex: The soldiers paraded down the street.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们列队行进在街上。
words.en: Formally assembled and displayed in a line or formation, typically for inspection or ceremony.

words.tr: v. 回报；报答；往复；来回
words.ex: She helped me, and I will reciprocate.
words.ex_cn: 她帮了我，我会回报她。
words.en: If your feelings or actions towards someone are reciprocated, the other person feels or behaves in the same way towards you as you have felt or behaved towards them.

words.ex: The children's reactions were funny and loud.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们的反应又有趣又大声。
words.en: A reaction is a response to something that has happened or been said, or is the process of reacting to something.

words.ex: He bought a stake in the new company.
words.ex_cn: 他购买了这家新公司的股份。
words.en: A stake is a pointed stick or post that is pushed into the ground, for example to support a young tree. It can also refer to a share or interest in a business, situation, or system.

words.ex: The lion returned to its lair at night.
words.ex_cn: 狮子晚上回到了它的兽穴。
words.en: A lair is a place where a wild animal lives, often hidden or difficult to find.

words.tr: v. 咆哮；怒吼；大声抱怨
words.ex: He was ranting about the unfair treatment at work.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大声抱怨工作中的不公平待遇。
words.en: To speak or shout at length in a wild, impassioned way.

words.ex: The vampire drinks blood at night.
words.ex_cn: 吸血鬼在夜里喝血。
words.en: A vampire is a mythical creature that subsists by feeding on the vital essence (generally in the form of blood) of the living.

words.ex: He bought a new gadget to clean his kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一个新的小器具来清洁厨房。
words.en: A gadget is a small device or machine with a particular purpose.

words.tr: adj. 有疑心的，不相信的 v. 怀疑，疑惑( doubt的现在分词 )
words.ex: He is doubting his answer.
words.ex_cn: 他正在怀疑自己的答案。
words.en: If you are doubting something, you are uncertain about it and do not know whether it is true or possible.

words.ex: He picked a random number to win the prize.
words.ex_cn: 他随意选了一个数字来赢得奖品。
words.en: If you describe something as random, you mean that it happens or is chosen without any definite plan, pattern, or purpose.

words.ex: The spider has eight legs, so it is legged.
words.ex_cn: 蜘蛛有八条腿，所以它是多腿的。
words.en: Having legs, especially of a specified kind or number.

words.tr:
v. 倒带；重绕
n. 倒带；重绕
words.ex: He wants to rewind the video to see the part again.
words.ex_cn: 他想倒带视频再看一遍那一部分。
words.en: To wind back a tape or film to an earlier point.

words.ex: He stayed home because of illness.
words.ex_cn: 他因为生病待在家里。
words.en: An illness is a particular disease, especially one that is not very serious.

words.ex: He gave a eulogy for his grandmother.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的祖母致了悼词。
words.en: A eulogy is a speech or piece of writing that praises someone or something highly, typically someone who has just died.

words.tr: adj. 男子汉气概的；大男子主义的
words.ex: He acts macho to impress his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他为了给朋友留下深刻印象而表现得阳刚。
words.en: If you describe a man as macho, you mean that he behaves in a way that is traditionally associated with men, such as being very strong, brave, or aggressive.

words.tr: n. 乳臭未干的小孩；顽童
words.ex: The brat screamed for candy in the store.
words.ex_cn: 那个顽童在商店里大喊要糖果。
words.en: A brat is a child who behaves badly.

words.ex: The school needs more resources for students.
words.ex_cn: 学校需要为学生提供更多的资源。
words.en: Resources are materials, money, and other assets that can be used to function effectively.

words.ex: He is a strong comer in the talent show.
words.ex_cn: 他在才艺比赛中是个有成功希望的人。
words.en: A comer is someone who arrives somewhere or someone who is likely to be successful in the future.

words.ex: The fossil of a trilobite was discovered in the rock layers.
words.ex_cn: 在岩层中发现了一块三叶虫的化石。
words.en: A trilobite is an extinct marine arthropod that was abundant during the Paleozoic era.

words.tr: adj. 歪曲的；不正当的；性变态的; v. 使入歧途（pervert 的过去分词）
words.ex: The perverted use of technology for illegal activities is a growing concern.
words.ex_cn: 将技术用于非法活动是一种日益严重的担忧。
words.en: If you say that someone is perverted, you mean that you consider their behaviour, especially their sexual behaviour, to be immoral or unacceptable.

words.ex: Caroline walks to school every morning.
words.ex_cn: 卡罗琳每天早上步行去学校。
words.en: A female given name, often used as a given name or surname.

words.tr:
v. 怒吼；激昂地说
n. 喧闹的话；夸口话；叫喊
words.ex: He went on a rant about bad service.
words.ex_cn: 他大肆抱怨服务很差。
words.en: To speak or write in an angry or violent manner, often for a long time.

words.ex: He starts his new class in the fall semester.
words.ex_cn: 他在秋季学期开始他的新课程。
words.en: A semester is one of the two periods that the school or college year is divided into, especially in the United States and Canada.

words.ex: The teacher turned on the projector to show the video.
words.ex_cn: 老师打开投影仪来播放视频。
words.en: A projector is a machine that projects films or slides onto a screen or wall.

words.tr:
n. 亲笔签名；亲笔稿
v. 亲笔签名于；亲笔书写
words.ex: He asked the singer for an autograph.
words.ex_cn: 他向歌手要了一张签名。
words.en: An autograph is a person's own signature, especially that of a famous person, or a manuscript in the author's own handwriting.

words.ex: The seller gave me a receipt.
words.ex_cn: 卖方给了我一张收据。
words.en: A seller is a person or organization that sells something.

words.tr:
v. 呻吟；呼啸；抱怨
n. 呻吟声；萧萧声；抱怨
words.ex: He moans when he is tired.
words.ex_cn: 他累了的时候会呻吟。
words.en: If you moan, you make a low sound, usually because you are unhappy or in pain.

words.ex: He read the previous chapter last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚读了前一章。
words.en: Existing or occurring before in time or order.

words.ex: Wesley is walking to school every morning.
words.ex_cn: 韦斯利每天早上走路去学校。
words.en: A male given name, derived from the Old English elements 'west' meaning 'west' and 'leah' meaning 'wood, clearing'.

words.tr:
n. 绷带
v. 用绷带包扎
words.ex: He put a bandage on his cut finger.
words.ex_cn: 他在他割伤的手指上贴了绷带。
words.en: A bandage is a piece of material used to cover a wound or to support an injured part of the body.

words.tr: n. 流行乐团迷；追星少女
words.ex: The groupie followed the band to every concert.
words.ex_cn: 这个追星族跟着乐队参加每一场演唱会。
words.en: A groupie is someone, especially a young woman, who follows a pop group or other celebrity, especially in the hope of having a sexual relationship with them.

words.ex: He was flexing his muscles in front of the mirror.
words.ex_cn: 他正在镜子前展示他的肌肉。
words.en: The act of bending or moving a joint or muscle, especially to show strength or agility.

words.tr: n. 浴室；洗手间；“bathroom”的复数；
words.ex: The hotel has clean bathrooms on every floor.
words.ex_cn: 这家酒店每层都有干净的浴室。
words.en: A room containing a bath or shower and typically also a washbasin and a toilet.

words.ex: She eats fruits to get vitamins.
words.ex_cn: 她吃水果来获取维生素。
words.en: Vitamins are substances that are found in foods and are necessary for normal growth and health.

words.ex: She walked sexily down the runway.
words.ex_cn: 她性感地走过T台。
words.en: In a sexually attractive or alluring manner.

words.ex: He lost his spleen in a car accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在一场车祸中失去了脾脏。
words.en: The spleen is an organ involved in the production and removal of blood cells in most vertebrates and forming part of the immune system. It can also refer to feelings of anger or spite.

words.ex: The pipe ruptured and water flooded the floor.
words.ex_cn: 管道破裂了，水淹了地板。
words.en: Torn or broken apart, especially a bodily tissue or a sealed container.

words.ex: Archie is playing soccer with his friends.
words.ex_cn: 阿奇正在和朋友们踢足球。
words.en: Archie is a male given name, often a nickname for Archibald, meaning 'genuine, bold, brave'.

words.ex: He wrote codes to make the app work.
words.ex_cn: 他编写了代码来让应用程序运行。
words.en: A code is a system of words, letters, figures, or other symbols substituted for other words, letters, etc., especially for the purposes of secrecy.

words.ex: He drove an old jalopy that barely made it up the hill.
words.ex_cn: 他开着一辆几乎爬不上山的破旧汽车。
words.en: An old, dilapidated car.

words.tr: n. （投出后落在击球员前的）贴板球
words.ex: He is a New Yorker.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名纽约人。
words.en: A person from Yorkshire, a historic county of northern England.

words.ex: He disappointed his parents by failing the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他考试不及格，让父母失望了。
words.en: If things or people disappoint you, they are not as good as you had hoped, or do not do what you expected them to do.

words.ex: The dog has parasites in its stomach.
words.ex_cn: 这只狗的胃里有寄生虫。
words.en: An organism that lives in or on another organism (its host) and benefits by deriving nutrients at the host's expense.

words.ex: Measles is a communicable disease.
words.ex_cn: 麻疹是一种会传染的疾病。
words.en: A communicable disease is one that can be passed from one person or animal to another.

words.ex: He put mayonnaise on his sandwich.
words.ex_cn: 他在三明治上加了蛋黄酱。
words.en: A thick, creamy dressing consisting of egg yolks beaten with oil and vinegar and seasoned.

words.tr: n. 脆片；脆玉米片（常指早餐谷物）
words.ex: He eats crispies for breakfast every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃脆米片当早餐。
words.en: Thin, crisp biscuits or cookies.

words.ex: He asked for assistance with his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他请求帮助做作业。
words.en: The act of helping or supporting someone or something.

words.ex: After work, he likes to unwind by listening to music.
words.ex_cn: 下班后，他喜欢听音乐来放松。
words.en: If you unwind, you relax after doing something that has made you tense or tired.

words.tr: adj. 迅速增长的；蓬勃发展的
words.ex: The booming tech industry is a burgeoning field.
words.ex_cn: 蓬勃发展的科技行业是一个新兴领域。
words.en: Performing the work of a surgeon, especially in a makeshift or informal setting.

words.tr: n. 民意调查；民意调查的结果；民意调查( poll的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The polls show that most people support the new law.
words.ex_cn: 民意调查显示大多数人支持这项新法律。
words.en: Opinions or votes collected from a representative sample of people.

words.tr: n. 反复无常；任性；怪想
words.ex: Her decision to quit the job was a sudden caprice.
words.ex_cn: 她决定辞职是突如其来的任性之举。
words.en: A sudden and unaccountable change of mood or behavior.

words.ex: The kats are sleeping on the sofa.
words.ex_cn: 这些猫正在沙发上睡觉。
words.en: A colloquial term for cats, often used informally.

words.ex: The eastern city has many old temples.
words.ex_cn: 东部的城市有许多古老的寺庙。
words.en: Eastern means in or from the east part of an area.

words.ex: He ate fresh oysters for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚餐吃了新鲜的牡蛎。
words.en: Edible mollusks found in shells, often served raw or cooked, known for their briny flavor and high zinc content.

words.ex: He looks for new opportunities every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都在寻找新的机会。
words.en: A time or set of circumstances that makes it possible to do something.

words.ex: He ate a fresh oyster for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚餐吃了一个新鲜的牡蛎。
words.en: An oyster is a large flat shellfish. Some oysters can be eaten and others produce valuable objects called pearls.

words.tr: n. 催欲剂；刺激性欲的食物或药物
words.ex: Chocolate is often considered an aphrodisiac.
words.ex_cn: 巧克力常被认为是一种催欲剂。
words.en: An aphrodisiac is a food or drug that arouses sexual desire.

words.tr: adj. 感官的；肉欲的；愉悦感官的；耽于肉欲的
words.ex: The sensual smell of fresh bread made her hungry.
words.ex_cn: 新鲜面包的感官香味让她感到饥饿。
words.en: Relating to or involving gratification of the senses and physical, especially sexual, pleasure.

words.tr: n. 一种原产于东非和阿拉伯半岛的植物，其叶子含有兴奋剂，常被咀嚼或泡茶饮用。
words.ex: The leaves of the kat plant are often chewed for their stimulant effects.
words.ex_cn: n. 卡塔叶常因其兴奋作用而被咀嚼。
words.en: A plant native to East Africa and the Arabian Peninsula, the leaves of which contain a stimulant and are often chewed or brewed as tea.

words.tr: adv. 三心二意地；不热心地；敷衍地
words.ex: He halfheartedly clapped when the show ended.
words.ex_cn: 演出结束时，他心不在焉地鼓了鼓掌。
words.en: Done without enthusiasm, commitment, or full effort.

words.ex: The cake was filled with chopped hazelnuts.
words.ex_cn: 蛋糕里填满了切碎的榛子。
words.en: A hazelnut is the nut of the hazel and is also known as a cobnut or filbert nut according to species.

words.ex: He is traveling to Brazil next month.
words.ex_cn: 他下个月要去巴西旅行。
words.en: Brazil is a country in South America, known for its vast Amazon rainforest and vibrant culture.

words.tr: v. 假装；伪装；乔装打扮（masquerade 的现在分词形式）
words.ex: He is masquerading as a doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他正假扮成一名医生。
words.en: Pretending to be someone or something else, often for deception.

words.tr: adj. 押韵的 v. （使）押韵，押…韵( rhyme的过去式和过去分词 ); （词或音节）押韵，
words.ex: The poem rhymed at the end of each line.
words.ex_cn: 这首诗每行的结尾都押韵。
words.en: If a word or line of poetry rhymes, it ends with a sound that is similar to that of another word or line of poetry.

words.ex: I had a bagel with lox for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: n. 我早餐吃了一个配熏鲑鱼的百吉饼。
words.en: Lox is salmon that has been cured in a brine solution and then cold-smoked.

words.ex: He felt like a chump after paying for everyone's dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他付了所有人的晚餐后感觉自己像个笨蛋。
words.en: A chump is a person who is easily tricked or who behaves in a silly way.

words.tr:
n. 胆汁；胆量；怨恨；磨伤
v. 使愤怒（尤指因不公平引起）
words.ex: The bitter gall made him feel sick.
words.ex_cn: 苦涩的胆汁让他感到恶心。
words.en: Gall can refer to a bitter liquid produced by the liver, or it can describe someone's boldness or impudence. It can also mean to irritate or annoy someone.

words.ex: He has a nu of doubt about the plan.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个计划有一点怀疑。
words.en: An abbreviation for 'number', used in informal contexts.

words.tr: n. 影响；效果；效应；作用；“effect”的复数；
words.ex: The effects of pollution are harmful to animals.
words.ex_cn: 污染对动物有有害的影响。
words.en: Effects refer to the results or consequences of an action or other cause.

words.tr: v. 点燃；照亮；“light”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: The lamp was lighted by the child.
words.ex_cn: 灯被孩子点亮了。
words.en: To make something start burning; to provide light for a place.

words.tr: n. 少女；少妇；乡下姑娘
words.ex: The wench cleaned the table quickly.
words.ex_cn: 那个女仆迅速地擦了桌子。
words.en: A wench is a young woman or girl, especially one who is lively and cheerful.

words.tr: adj. 赚大钱的；获利多的；
words.ex: He took a lucrative job at a tech company.
words.ex_cn: 他去了一家科技公司做一份赚大钱的工作。
words.en: A lucrative activity or job is one that you can earn a lot of money from.

words.ex: Stockbrokers buy and sell stocks for clients.
words.ex_cn: 股票经纪人为客户买卖股票。
words.en: Stockbrokers are professionals who buy and sell stocks and other securities on behalf of their clients, often providing advice on investment strategies.

words.tr: n. 储备；股票；“stock”的复数； v. 备有；
words.ex: The store has large stocks of canned food.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店有大量罐头食品的储备。
words.en: Stocks are shares in the ownership of a company, which can be bought and sold on the stock market.

words.ex: He has a knack for fixing bikes.
words.ex_cn: 他有修自行车的技巧。
words.en: A knack is a special skill or ability that someone has, especially one that is hard to explain or teach.

words.ex: He paid 1000 yen for the sushi.
words.ex_cn: 他用一千日元买了寿司。
words.en: The yen is the unit of currency used in Japan. It can also mean a strong desire or craving for something.

words.tr: n. 卢布（俄罗斯等国的货币单位，复数形式）
words.ex: He paid five rubles for the bread.
words.ex_cn: 他用五个卢布买了面包。
words.en: The basic monetary unit of Russia and several other countries.

words.tr: n. （墨西哥、菲律宾等国的）比索（ peso 的复数形式）
words.ex: He paid for the bread with five pesos.
words.ex_cn: 他用五比索买了面包。
words.en: The basic monetary unit of Mexico and several other countries.

words.tr: adj. 敬畏的；肃然起敬的
words.ex: She was awestruck by the huge mountain.
words.ex_cn: 她被那座巨大的山峰震撼了。
words.en: Filled with awe, wonder, or admiration, often to the point of being speechless.

words.ex: Their undying love for each other was admired by all.
words.ex_cn: 他们对彼此不朽的爱被所有人所羡慕。
words.en: If you refer to someone's undying feelings, you mean that the feelings are very strong and are unlikely to change.

words.ex: They exchanged vows at the wedding ceremony.
words.ex_cn: 他们在婚礼上交换了誓言。
words.en: A vow is a solemn promise or pledge, especially one made to a deity or in a religious context.

words.ex: The sanctity of life is a fundamental principle in many cultures.
words.ex_cn: 生命的神圣是许多文化中的一个基本原则。
words.en: The state or quality of being holy, sacred, or saintly.

words.ex: She was a busty woman with a curvaceous figure.
words.ex_cn: 她是一位胸部丰满、曲线优美的女性。
words.en: Having a large bust; full-bosomed.

words.ex: Children find joys in playing with toys.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在玩玩具时找到快乐。
words.en: Joys are feelings of great happiness and pleasure.

words.tr: v. 深思，细想，仔细考虑( contemplate的现在分词 ); 注视，凝视; 考虑接受（发生某
words.ex: He spent hours contemplating the painting.
words.ex_cn: 他花了几个小时仔细考虑那幅画。
words.en: Thinking deeply or seriously about something.

words.ex: The game has age restrictions.
words.ex_cn: 这个游戏有年龄约束。
words.en: Restrictions are rules or laws that limit what you can do or what can happen.

words.tr: adj. 行星间的；太阳系内的
words.ex: The spaceship travels through interplanetary space.
words.ex_cn: 宇宙飞船在星际空间中航行。
words.en: Existing or occurring between planets.

words.ex: The birds perform a dance during courtship.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类在求偶时会跳舞。
words.en: The period during which a couple develop a romantic relationship, especially with a view to marriage.

words.tr: v. 认出( recognize的现在分词 ); 承认[认清]（某事物）; 赏识; 承认…有效[属实
words.ex: He was recognizing the symptoms of the disease.
words.ex_cn: 他正在识别这种疾病的症状。
words.en: to know someone or something because you have seen or heard them or it before

words.ex: They make a perfect twosome on the dance floor.
words.ex_cn: 他们在舞池里是一对完美的搭档。
words.en: A twosome is a pair of people, often considered together because they are similar in some way or because they are doing something together.

words.tr: v. 参与；从事；吸引；与…建立密切关系；
words.ex: He engages in community volunteer work.
words.ex_cn: 他参与社区志愿工作。
words.en: To engage means to occupy, attract, or involve someone or oneself in a particular activity or situation.

words.tr: v. 放开；发布；释放( release的现在分词 )；
words.ex: He was releasing the rope slowly.
words.ex_cn: 他正在慢慢放开绳子。
words.en: The act of making something available or setting free.

words.ex: He finished his homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭前完成了家庭作业。
words.en: Homework is school work that teachers give to pupils to do at home in the evening or at the weekend.

words.ex: He spat out spittle after tasting the bitter medicine.
words.ex_cn: 他尝了苦药后吐出了口水。
words.en: Saliva, especially as ejected from the mouth.

words.ex: The cat crouched behind the bush.
words.ex_cn: 猫蹲在灌木丛后面。
words.en: To bend your knees and lower your body so that you are close to the ground or lying on your heels.

words.ex: She felt pure bliss when she held her newborn baby.
words.ex_cn: 当她抱住新生儿时，感受到了无上的幸福。
words.en: Bliss is a state of complete happiness.

words.ex: The tree grew vertically toward the sky.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树垂直地向天空生长。
words.en: In a vertical direction or position.

words.tr: v. 追忆，回想( reminisce的现在分词 )
words.ex: They spent the evening reminiscing about their childhood.
words.ex_cn: 他们整个晚上都在回忆他们的童年。
words.en: The act of recalling or thinking fondly about past events or experiences.

words.tr:
adj. 相配的；不相上下的
v. 相配；“match”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: The curtains are perfectly matched with the furniture.
words.ex_cn: 窗帘与家具完美搭配。
words.en: If one thing matches another, they are connected or suit each other in some way.

words.tr: v. 抱怨，诉苦，投诉；申诉，控诉，抗议；诉说，申诉；抱怨，诉苦，投诉( complain的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: He complained about the noisy neighbors.
words.ex_cn: 他抱怨邻居很吵。
words.en: If you complain about a situation, you say that you are not satisfied with it.

words.tr:
v. 咕哝；（猪等）打呼噜
n. 咕哝；呼噜声
words.ex: He grunted when he lifted the heavy box.
words.ex_cn: 他搬起沉重的箱子时咕哝了一声。
words.en: To make a low, short guttural sound, typically to express dissatisfaction or effort.

words.ex: The road widens as you leave the city.
words.ex_cn: v. 当你离开城市时，道路变宽了。
words.en: To make or become wider or broader.

words.tr:
v. （使）变黑；中伤；诋毁；“blacken”的过去式和过去分词
adj. 变黑的
words.ex: The blackened walls were evidence of a recent fire.
words.ex_cn: 变黑的墙壁是最近火灾的证据。
words.en: To make or become black or dark, especially by the action of fire or smoke.

words.tr: n. 研究；学习；“study”的复数； v. 研究；学习；
words.ex: His studies show that sleep helps memory.
words.ex_cn: 他的研究显示睡眠有助于记忆。
words.en: The act of learning or acquiring knowledge, especially from books or through systematic investigation.

words.ex: They went to the spas to relax after work.
words.ex_cn: 他们下班后去温泉放松。
words.en: A spa is a place where water with minerals in it comes out of the ground and people go to drink the water or swim in it in order to improve their health. A spa is also a place where people go to relax and improve their health by having special treatments.

words.tr: n. （旅馆、事务所等雇用的）接待员( receptionist的名词复数 )
words.ex: The receptionists at the hotel were very helpful.
words.ex_cn: 这家酒店的接待员非常乐于助人。
words.en: A receptionist is a person whose job is to deal with people arriving at or telephoning a hotel, office building, doctor's surgery, etc.

words.ex: The farmer sown seeds in the field last week.
words.ex_cn: 农夫上周在田里播了种子。
words.en: Sown is the past participle of sow, which means to plant seeds in the ground so that they will grow into plants.

words.tr:
n. 淡水；
adj. 淡水的；
words.ex: Fish live in freshwater lakes.
words.ex_cn: 鱼生活在淡水湖中。
words.en: Freshwater refers to water that is not salty, especially water in rivers and lakes.

words.ex: The eel slid quietly through the water.
words.ex_cn: 鳗鱼静静地滑过水里。
words.en: An eel is a long, thin fish that looks like a snake. Some eels live in rivers and others live in the sea.

words.ex: He made a basket from bamboo.
words.ex_cn: 他用竹子做了一个篮子。
words.en: Bamboo is a tall tropical plant with hard, hollow stems. The young shoots of the plant can be eaten and the stems are used to make furniture.

words.ex: He checks the calendar every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都看日历。
words.en: A calendar is a chart or device which displays the date and the day of the week, and often the whole of a particular year divided up into months, weeks, and days.

words.tr: n. 掠夺者；捕食性动物；食肉动物；
words.ex: The lion is a predator that hunts deer.
words.ex_cn: 狮子是一种捕食鹿的掠夺者。
words.en: A predator is an animal that naturally preys on others.

words.ex: The seasons follow a yearly cycle.
words.ex_cn: 季节遵循一年一度的周期。
words.en: Cycles refer to a series of events that are regularly repeated in the same order, or a complete sequence of a recurring phenomenon such as the phases of the moon. It can also mean to ride a bicycle.

words.ex: The importance of homework is clear.
words.ex_cn: 作业的重要性是显而易见的。
words.en: The quality or state of being important; significance.

words.ex: The company made drastic cuts to save money.
words.ex_cn: 公司进行了急剧的削减以节省资金。
words.en: If you describe a change or action as drastic, you mean that it is extreme and often severe.

words.tr: adj. 像女孩子的；少女般的
words.ex: She has a girlish laugh.
words.ex_cn: 她的笑声很少女。
words.en: If you describe a woman or her behavior as girlish, you mean she behaves like a young girl, for example by being shy or playful.

words.ex: The meeting has begun.
words.ex_cn: 会议已经开始了。
words.en: Past participle of begin: to start doing something.

words.ex: Bad luck may befall anyone at any time.
words.ex_cn: 坏运气可能随时降临到任何人身上。
words.en: If something bad or unlucky befalls you, it happens to you.

words.ex: He has awareness of the environmental problems.
words.ex_cn: 他意识到环境问题。
words.en: Knowledge or perception of a situation or fact.

words.tr: v. 实现；取得；取得( achieve的现在分词 )；
words.ex: He is achieving his dream of becoming a doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他正在实现成为医生的梦想。
words.en: to succeed in finishing something or reaching an aim, especially after a lot of work or effort

words.ex: His greed made him steal money from his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他的贪婪让他偷了朋友的钱。
words.en: Greed is the desire to have more of something, such as food or money, than is necessary or fair.

words.tr: adj. 上升的； v. 上升；提高；“rise”的现在分词； n. 上升；
words.ex: The rising sun warmed the earth.
words.ex_cn: 上升的太阳温暖了大地。
words.en: Going up, increasing, or becoming higher or greater.

words.tr:
n. 轨道；
v. 绕...轨道而行；
words.ex: The moon moves around the Earth in an orbit.
words.ex_cn: 月亮围绕地球在轨道上运行。
words.en: An orbit is the curved path, usually elliptical, described by a planet, satellite, spaceship, etc., around a celestial body, as the sun.

words.tr: v. 环绕...运行（orbit 的过去式和过去分词）
words.ex: The satellite orbited the Earth once every 90 minutes.
words.ex_cn: 卫星每90分钟绕地球一圈。
words.en: To have orbited or moved in a curved path around a celestial body.

words.tr: n. 地球升起（指从月球或其他天体上看到地球从地平线上升起的现象）
words.ex: The astronaut saw earthrise above the moon.
words.ex_cn: 宇航员在月球上方看到了地球升起。
words.en: The phenomenon of the Earth appearing to rise above the horizon from the Moon's surface.

words.ex: He bought a replica of the ancient statue.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一件古代雕像的复制品。
words.en: A replica of something such as a statue, building, or weapon is an accurate copy of it.

words.tr: n. 阿波罗（希腊神话中的太阳神）
words.ex: Apollo is often depicted with a radiant crown and holding a lyre.
words.ex_cn: 阿波罗常被描绘成戴着光芒四射的冠冕，手持里拉琴。
words.en: In Greek mythology, Apollo is the god of the sun, music, and poetry. The Apollo program was a series of space missions undertaken by the United States with the goal of landing a man on the Moon and returning him safely to Earth.

words.tr: n. 攻击者；袭击者；进攻者
words.ex: The attacker ran away quickly.
words.ex_cn: 袭击者迅速逃跑了。
words.en: An attacker is a person who attacks someone or something.

words.tr: adj. 未损坏的；完好无损
words.ex: The box was undamaged after the delivery.
words.ex_cn: 包裹送达后完好无损。
words.en: Not harmed or damaged; intact.

words.ex: He repainted the old house last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周重新粉刷了那栋老房子。
words.en: To paint something again, especially to give it a new appearance or to cover old paint.

words.tr: adj. 清洁的；无瑕疵的；无过失的
words.ex: The kitchen was immaculate after she cleaned it.
words.ex_cn: 她打扫后，厨房非常干净。
words.en: If you describe something as immaculate, you mean that it is extremely clean, tidy, or neat.

words.tr: n. 唾液球（儿童用唾液和纸揉成的小球，常用于恶作剧）
words.ex: The boys threw spitballs in class.
words.ex_cn: 男孩们在课堂上扔纸团。
words.en: Small, soft projectiles, often made of paper, used in informal games or as a light-hearted gesture.

words.ex: He got good grades in math and science.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学和科学中取得了好成绩。
words.en: A grade is a level of quality, rank, or value that is used to classify or compare things. In education, it refers to the score or mark given to a student's work.

words.ex: The teacher gave us a handbook for the science project.
words.ex_cn: 老师给我们发了一本科学项目的手册。
words.en: A handbook is a type of reference work, or other collection of instructions, that is intended to provide ready reference.

words.tr: n. 热门人物（常指外貌吸引人的人）；性感的人
words.ex: The hotties are dancing at the party.
words.ex_cn: 那些性感的人在派对上跳舞。
words.en: Slang for very attractive people, especially women.

words.ex: She spins yarns to make sweaters.
words.ex_cn: 她纺纱线来织毛衣。
words.en: Yarns are long, continuous lengths of interlocked fibers, used in knitting, weaving, or sewing. Also, yarns can refer to entertaining stories or tales.

words.tr: n. （旧时）一种小型鲱鱼，常用于制作鱼干
words.ex: The word 'caplin' is not a valid English word.
words.ex_cn: ‘caplin’ 不是一个有效的英文单词。
words.en: A small fish of the cod family, often used as bait.

words.ex: The keystone holds the arch together.
words.ex_cn: 拱顶石将拱门固定在一起。
words.en: A keystone is the central, topmost stone in an arch, which holds all the other stones in place. Metaphorically, it refers to the central principle or part of a system, plan, etc., upon which all else depends.

words.ex: He is rejecting the offer because it pays too little.
words.ex_cn: 他正在拒绝这个提议，因为报酬太低。
words.en: To refuse to accept, consider, or use something or someone.

words.ex: The editing of the book took three months.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的编辑花了三个月。
words.en: The process of revising and preparing a written, recorded, or filmed material for publication or presentation.

words.ex: He edits the school newspaper every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周编辑校报。
words.en: To prepare written material for publication by correcting, condensing, or otherwise modifying it.

words.ex: Howie is playing soccer with his friends.
words.ex_cn: Howie 正在和朋友们踢足球。
words.en: A colloquial shortening of the name Howard, often used informally.

words.ex: She used a straightener to smooth her curly hair.
words.ex_cn: 她使用直发器来拉直她的卷发。
words.en: A straightener is a device used to make something straight, especially hair or metal.

words.ex: The kitchen has a new washing appliance.
words.ex_cn: 厨房里有一台新的洗衣机。
words.en: An appliance is a device or machine that is used to perform a particular task, especially in the home.

words.ex: He is preparing for his exams this week.
words.ex_cn: 他这周正在为考试做准备。
words.en: An exam is a formal test that you take to show your knowledge or ability in a particular subject, or to obtain a qualification.

words.tr:
v. 指引；
n. 导演；
words.ex: He is directing the team to the right path.
words.ex_cn: 他正在指引团队走向正确的道路。
words.en: Directing involves guiding or managing the performance or operation of something, such as a film, play, or organization.

words.ex: The teacher gave an evaluation of the student's work.
words.ex_cn: 老师对学生的作业进行了评估。
words.en: An evaluation is a judgment about how good, useful, or successful something is.

words.ex: The location of the store is near the park.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店的位置在公园附近。
words.en: A location is the place where something happens or is situated.

words.tr: n. （非正式）碎屑；面包屑（常用于儿童用语或方言）
words.ex: The child ate the last crumbies from the cookie plate.
words.ex_cn: 孩子吃掉了盘子里最后的碎饼干。
words.en: Small pieces or fragments, especially of food or debris.

words.ex: He performed a mime on the street.
words.ex_cn: 他在街上表演了哑剧。
words.en: A mime is a form of performance art where the performer uses gestures and movements without speech to convey a story or emotion. As a verb, to mime means to imitate or mimic actions or expressions without using words.

words.tr:
n. 压力；（动植物的）品种；
v. 竭力；
words.ex: The job gave him a lot of strain.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作给他带来了很大的压力。
words.en: To strain means to make a great effort to do something, to pull or stretch something tightly, or to injure a muscle by stretching it too much.

words.tr: v. 紧咬（牙）； grit 的现在分词形式，指用力咬紧牙齿以忍耐痛苦或决心坚持
words.ex: He is gritting his teeth during the race.
words.ex_cn: 他在跑步时咬紧牙关。
words.en: The act of spreading grit on icy surfaces to prevent slipping.

words.tr: v. (refill 的过去式和过去分词) 再装满；重新注入；再填满
words.ex: He refilled the water bottle.
words.ex_cn: 他把水瓶重新装满了。
words.en: To fill something again after it has been emptied or used.

words.ex: He used dry leaves as kindling to start the fire.
words.ex_cn: 他用干树叶作为引火物来生火。
words.en: Material that burns easily and is used for starting a fire.

words.ex: It is a taboo to speak his name in this village.
words.ex_cn: 在这个村子里，提到他的名字是禁忌。
words.en: A taboo is a social or religious custom prohibiting or restricting a particular practice or forbidding association with a particular person, place, or thing.

words.ex: He attends three lectures every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周上三节讲课。
words.en: Lectures are talks that are given to a group of people to teach them about a particular subject, often as part of a university or college course.

words.tr: n. 性感的人；有吸引力的人
words.ex: He thinks she is a hottie.
words.ex_cn: 他认为她是个美女。
words.en: A hottie is someone who is very attractive or sexy.

words.ex: The teacher gave evaluations for each student's project.
words.ex_cn: 老师对每个学生的项目进行了评估。
words.en: Evaluations are the process of judging or calculating the quality, importance, amount, or value of something.

words.tr: v. 皱眉，表示不满或困惑
words.ex: She frowned when she heard the news.
words.ex_cn: 她听到这个消息时皱起了眉头。
words.en: To furrow one's brow in displeasure or concentration.

words.ex: He posted an anonymous comment online.
words.ex_cn: 他在网上发布了一条匿名评论。
words.en: If you remain anonymous when you do something, you do not let people know that you were the person who did it.

words.ex: The barges carry coal down the river.
words.ex_cn: 驳船沿着河流运送煤炭。
words.en: Large flat-bottomed boats used for transporting goods on rivers and canals.

words.tr:
v. 磨碎；磨擦；（使）烦躁；发出磨擦声
n. 炉栅；炉箅
words.ex: The food was grated into small pieces.
words.ex_cn: 食物被擦成了小块。
words.en: To grate means to reduce food to small shreds by rubbing it on a grater. It can also mean to make a harsh, scraping sound or to cause irritation or annoyance.

words.tr: v. （binge 的现在分词）沉迷于；过度消费；连续不断地做某事
words.ex: He was bingeing on chips all night.
words.ex_cn: 他整晚都在狂吃薯片。
words.en: The act of consuming excessive amounts of food in a short period, often associated with a loss of control.

words.tr: n. 接通，开放，解锁 v. 开启; 揭开; 开锁( unlock的现在分词 ); 开着，解开
words.ex: He is unlocking the door with a key.
words.ex_cn: 他正在用钥匙开门。
words.en: The act of opening something that was locked or of making something available that was previously inaccessible.

words.ex: He massaged his sore shoulder after work.
words.ex_cn: 他下班后按摩了酸痛的肩膀。
words.en: Treated or manipulated with smooth, kneading motions, often to relax or improve texture.

words.tr:
adj. 合作的；
n. 合作社；
words.ex: The two companies made a cooperative effort to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 两家公司合作努力解决问题。
words.en: A cooperative is an organization or business that is owned and run jointly by its members, who share the profits or benefits.

words.tr: v. 提供；供应；“provide”的现在分词； conj. 如果；假如；在…条件下；
words.ex: The school is providing free lunches to students.
words.ex_cn: 学校为学生提供免费午餐。
words.en: Used to say that something will happen only if a particular condition is met.

words.ex: He is deemed honest by everyone.
words.ex_cn: 大家都认为他诚实。
words.en: To consider or judge something in a particular way.

words.tr: n. 户外烤肉（等于barbecue）; n. BARBIE，芭比娃娃
words.ex: We had a barbie in the backyard on Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 我们在周六后院举行了户外烤肉。
words.en: A popular fashion doll and toy brand, also referring to the doll itself.

words.ex: The child gave a whooping laugh.
words.ex_cn: 孩子发出了一阵大笑。
words.en: Making or characterized by a loud, excited shout or cry.

words.ex: Many tourists stay in hotels near the beach.
words.ex_cn: 许多游客住在靠近海滩的酒店里。
words.en: A hotel is a building where people stay, for example on holiday, paying for their rooms and meals.

words.ex: He eats a papaya every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃一个木瓜。
words.en: A papaya is a large oval fruit with green skin, sweet orange flesh, and small black seeds.

words.tr:
v. 提取；
n. 摘录；提取物；
words.ex: They extract oil from plants.
words.ex_cn: 他们从植物中提取油。
words.en: To remove or take out something, especially by effort or force.

words.tr: n. 防晒系数（Sun Protection Factor）
words.ex: Make sure to apply sunscreen with a high SPF before going to the beach.
words.ex_cn: n. 去海滩前确保涂抹高防晒系数的防晒霜。
words.en: Sun Protection Factor (SPF) is a measure of how well a sunscreen will protect skin from UVB rays, the kind of radiation that causes sunburn, damages skin, and can contribute to skin cancer.

words.ex: He watches MTV every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上看MTV。
words.en: MTV is a cable television channel that was originally created to play music videos guided by on-air hosts known as VJs.

words.ex: The sun's corona is visible during a total solar eclipse.
words.ex_cn: 太阳的日冕在日全食时可见。
words.en: The outermost part of the sun's atmosphere, visible as a white halo during a total solar eclipse.

words.tr:
v. 耳语；低语
n. 耳语；低语；沙沙的声音
words.ex: He whispered a secret to his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他向朋友低语了一个秘密。
words.en: To speak very quietly using one's breath rather than one's throat, especially for the sake of privacy.

words.ex: The refrigerator has a loud compressor.
words.ex_cn: 冰箱有一个很吵的压缩机。
words.en: A compressor is a device that increases the pressure of a gas by reducing its volume, typically used in air conditioning and refrigeration systems.

words.tr: n. 回路；环行；电路；巡回；
words.ex: The battery connects to the circuit to make the light work.
words.ex_cn: 电池连接到回路，使灯亮起来。
words.en: A circuit is a roughly circular line, route, or movement that starts and finishes at the same place. It can also refer to the complete path that an electric current travels along.

words.tr:
v. 咕哝；含糊地说
n. 含糊的话；咕哝
words.ex: He mumbles when he is tired.
words.ex_cn: 当他累了的时候，他会嘟囔。
words.en: If you mumble, you speak very quietly and not at all clearly with the result that the words are difficult to understand.

words.ex: She longs for a peaceful life.
words.ex_cn: 她渴望平静的生活。
words.en: To have a strong desire or wish for something.

words.ex: He has a dimple when he smiles.
words.ex_cn: 他笑的时候有一个酒窝。
words.en: A dimple is a small natural indentation in the flesh on a part of the human body, especially one formed in the cheeks when someone smiles.

words.ex: He is a weirdo who talks to himself.
words.ex_cn: 他是个自言自语的怪人。
words.en: A weirdo is someone who behaves in a way that is different from what is usual or socially acceptable, often in a way that is strange or amusing.

words.tr: adj. 诡诈的；诡秘的；心照不宣的
words.ex: The sly fox stole the chicken at night.
words.ex_cn: 那只狡猾的狐狸在夜里偷了鸡。
words.en: Someone who is sly is clever and good at deceiving people in a way that is not easily noticed.

words.ex: The sunset was spectacular.
words.ex_cn: 日落非常壮观。
words.en: Something that is spectacular is very impressive or dramatic.

words.tr: v. 漫无目的地闲逛；拖着脚步走
words.ex: The kids were traipsing through the mud.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在泥巴里踩来踩去。
words.en: Walking wearily or aimlessly over a distance.

words.ex: The air conditioner keeps the room cool.
words.ex_cn: 空调使房间保持凉爽。
words.en: A conditioner is a substance that you put on your hair after you have washed it to make it softer.

words.ex: The stream flows quietly through the forest.
words.ex_cn: 小溪静静地流过森林。
words.en: A stream is a small, narrow river. It can also refer to a continuous flow of liquid, air, or gas, or a continuous flow of data or information.

words.ex: The box has four sided faces.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子有四个侧面。
words.en: Having sides or a specified number or type of sides.

words.ex: They shouted, 'Welcome home!' when he walked through the door.
words.ex_cn: 当他走进门时，他们大喊：‘欢迎回家！’
words.en: A greeting used to express pleasure at someone's return to their home.

words.ex: She makes crafts with paper and glue.
words.ex_cn: 她用纸和胶水做手工艺品。
words.en: Crafts refer to activities involving the making of decorative or functional objects by hand, often using traditional techniques.

words.ex: He visited Egypt last summer.
words.ex_cn: 他去年夏天去了埃及。
words.en: A country in northeastern Africa, known for its ancient civilization and monuments such as the pyramids.

words.tr: v. 组成；创作（音乐、文学作品等）；使平静
words.ex: She composes music for films.
words.ex_cn: 她为电影创作音乐。
words.en: To compose means to create or write music, poetry, or other artistic works, or to constitute or make up a whole. It can also mean to calm or settle oneself or one's features.

words.tr: v. 最终确定的；完成的；结束的
words.ex: He finalized the contract yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天完成了合同。
words.en: To have completed or settled something, such as an agreement or plan, in a final form.

words.ex: He wins many math contests.
words.ex_cn: 他赢得许多数学竞赛。
words.en: A contest is a competition or a struggle for victory between individuals or groups.

words.tr: adj. 短小的；少量的；贫乏的；不足的；吝啬的
words.ex: She wore a skimpy shirt that barely covered her shoulders.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一件短小的衬衫，几乎盖不住肩膀。
words.en: If you describe something as skimpy, you mean that there is not enough of it or that it is too small.

words.tr: adj. 分子的；分子构成的；
words.ex: Water is a molecular compound.
words.ex_cn: 水是一种分子化合物。
words.en: Relating to or consisting of molecules.

words.ex: He studies epidemiology to understand how diseases spread.
words.ex_cn: 他研究流行病学以了解疾病如何传播。
words.en: Epidemiology is the study of how often diseases occur in different groups of people and why. It is a key component of public health, and shapes policy decisions and evidence-based practice by identifying risk factors for disease and targets for preventive healthcare.

words.tr: prep. 关于； v. 看待；“regard”的现在分词；
words.ex: He sent me an email regarding the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他给我发了一封关于会议的邮件。
words.en: You can use regarding to indicate the subject that is being talked or written about.

words.ex: His loud voice angers the neighbors.
words.ex_cn: 他大声说话惹恼了邻居。
words.en: makes someone very angry

words.tr: n. 特征；特点；面貌特征；“feature”的复数； v. 以…为特色；
words.ex: The features of this phone are very useful.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机的特征非常有用。
words.en: A feature of something is an interesting or important part or characteristic of it.

words.ex: The movie is featuring a famous singer.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影 featuring 一位著名歌手。
words.en: If something features a particular person or thing, they are an important part of it.

words.tr: n. 过度表演；做作的表演
words.ex: He is overacting in the play.
words.ex_cn: 他在剧中演得过于夸张。
words.en: Exaggerating one's performance, especially in acting.

words.ex: The movie's soundtrack played softly during the ending scene.
words.ex_cn: 电影的配乐在结尾场景中轻轻播放。
words.en: The soundtrack is the music that has been specially written for a film.

words.tr: v. 报复；反击；以牙还牙
words.ex: He started retaliating after they insulted him.
words.ex_cn: 他们在侮辱他之后，他开始报复。
words.en: Responding to an attack or injury with a counterattack.

words.tr: v. 被猛咬；被野兽袭击（maul 的过去式和过去分词）
words.ex: The dog was maulled by a bear.
words.ex_cn: 那只狗被熊袭击了。
words.en: Injured or torn apart by a wild animal or violent force.

words.ex: He has allergies to pollen and dust.
words.ex_cn: 他对花粉和灰尘过敏。
words.en: Allergies are abnormal immune system reactions to things that are typically harmless to most people.

words.ex: The book is overdue at the library.
words.ex_cn: 这本书在图书馆逾期了。
words.en: If you say that a change or an event is overdue, you mean that you think it should have happened before now.

words.tr: adj. 奥地利的；奥地利人的；
words.ex: He bought an Austrian violin at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场上买了一把奥地利的小提琴。
words.en: Relating to Austria or its people.

words.ex: He has an allergy to peanuts.
words.ex_cn: 他对花生过敏。
words.en: An allergy is a condition in which your immune system reacts abnormally to a foreign substance.

words.tr: n. 路由；路径选择；（材料或产品的）加工路线安排
words.ex: The router uses routing to send data to the right place.
words.ex_cn: 路由器使用路由将数据发送到正确的地方。
words.en: Routing refers to the process of selecting paths in a network along which to send network traffic, or the act of directing or sending something along a particular path.

words.tr: abbr. 中央处理器；“Central Processing Unit”的缩写
words.ex: The CPU is the brain of the computer, responsible for executing instructions.
words.ex_cn: 中央处理器是计算机的大脑，负责执行指令。
words.en: The part of a computer in which operations are controlled and executed.

words.ex: The robot looks like a humanoid.
words.ex_cn: 这个机器人看起来像一个人形。
words.en: A humanoid is something that has an appearance resembling a human being.

words.tr: v. 增强；提高；“enhance”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 增强的；提高的；
words.ex: The new software enhanced the camera's quality.
words.ex_cn: 新软件增强了相机的画质。
words.en: If something is enhanced, it is made better or more effective.

words.ex: The police officer is an enforcer of the law.
words.ex_cn: 这位警察是法律的执行者。
words.en: An enforcer is someone whose job is to make sure that people obey a particular law or rule.

words.tr: adv. 用电子方法；用电子装置；运用电子仪器进行；
words.ex: She paid for the book electronically.
words.ex_cn: 她用电子方式支付了这本书的费用。
words.en: In a way that involves the use of electronic devices or technology.

words.tr:
adj. 计算机化的；有关计算机的
v. 使计算机化；用计算机做；“computerize”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: The school uses computerized tests for math.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校使用计算机化考试来测数学。
words.en: If something is computerized, it is done or controlled by computers.

words.tr: v. 运气好（lucky 的过去式和过去分词，非标准用法，通常应使用 'was lucky'）
words.ex: He lucked into a free ticket to the concert.
words.ex_cn: 他幸运地得到了一张音乐会的免费票。
words.en: Achieved success through luck rather than skill or effort.

words.tr: n. 环行；电路( circuit的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The birds flew in circuits around the tower.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿在塔周围盘旋。
words.en: A circuit is a roughly circular line, route, or movement that starts and finishes at the same place. It can also refer to the complete path that an electric current travels along.

words.tr: adv. 非常；极其地；极大地
words.ex: She improved tremendously after practicing every day.
words.ex_cn: 她每天练习后进步巨大。
words.en: To a very great extent or degree; extremely.

words.ex: Willis is walking to school every morning.
words.ex_cn: 威利斯每天早上走路去学校。
words.en: Willis is a surname and a given name of English origin.

words.tr:
n. 夜间活动；夜袭；（尤在夜间）从事第二职业
v. 兼职；（尤在夜间）从事第二职业；“moonlight”的现在分词】
words.ex: He has moonlighting as a taxi driver after his day job.
words.ex_cn: 他在白天工作之后，晚上开出租车。
words.en: Moonlighting refers to the practice of working at an extra job, especially without telling your main employer.

words.ex: Many people believe that climate change could lead to an environmental armageddon.
words.ex_cn: 许多人认为气候变化可能导致环境的世界末日。
words.en: Armageddon refers to the site of a final battle between the forces of good and evil, or more generally, any catastrophic conflict or disaster.

words.ex: The termination of the contract surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 合同的终止让所有人都感到惊讶。
words.en: The act of ending something or the end of something.

words.ex: The shipment arrived on time.
words.ex_cn: 运输按时到达了。
words.en: The act of sending goods from one place to another, especially by ship.

words.tr: n. 奥马哈（美国城市名）
words.ex: Omaha is a city in the state of Nebraska.
words.ex_cn: n. 奥马哈是内布拉斯加州的一个城市。
words.en: Omaha is a city in the U.S. state of Nebraska, known for its cultural attractions and as the home of billionaire Warren Buffett.

words.tr: adj. 微红的；略带红色的
words.ex: The sky turned reddish at sunset.
words.ex_cn: 日落时，天空变得泛红。
words.en: Having a slight red color.

words.ex: The servants cleaned the house every morning.
words.ex_cn: 仆人们每天早上打扫房子。
words.en: A servant is someone who is employed to do household tasks for another person, or to work for someone in a position of authority.

words.tr: adj. 忠实的；虔诚的；可靠的；
words.ex: He is a faithful friend who always helps me.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个总是帮助我的忠实朋友。
words.en: Someone who is faithful remains loyal to a person, belief, or cause, and continues to support them.

words.ex: The child was tugging at his mother's sleeve to get her attention.
words.ex_cn: 孩子拉着母亲的袖子以引起她的注意。
words.en: to pull something hard or suddenly

words.ex: The doll has a lifelike face.
words.ex_cn: 这个玩具有一个逼真的脸。
words.en: If something is lifelike, it is very similar to the thing it represents or imitates, especially in a way that is surprising or impressive.

words.tr: n. <美>传闻( rumor的名词复数 ); [古]名誉; 咕哝; [古]喧嚷 v. <美>传闻(
words.ex: The rumors of his resignation spread quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他辞职的传闻迅速传开。
words.en: Unverified information or gossip about someone or something.

words.ex: The teacher berated the student for being late.
words.ex_cn: 老师因为学生迟到而责备了他。
words.en: To scold or criticize someone angrily.

words.ex: The terminator kills robots in the movie.
words.ex_cn: 终结者在电影里杀死机器人。
words.en: A terminator is someone or something that terminates, ends, or concludes something.

words.ex: The investigator asked the witness a few simple questions.
words.ex_cn: 调查员问了证人几个简单的问题。
words.en: An investigator is someone whose job is to investigate a crime, accident, or other matter.

words.tr: n. 马毛；马鬃；马毛织品
words.ex: The chair is made of horsehair.
words.ex_cn: 这把椅子是用马毛制成的。
words.en: Horsehair refers to the hair from the mane or tail of a horse, used especially in upholstery and for making violin bows.

words.tr: v. 提前；前进；“advance”的现在分词； adj. 前进的；
words.ex: He is advancing the meeting to Monday.
words.ex_cn: 他把会议提前到周一。
words.en: To move forward or make progress, especially in a purposeful way.

words.ex: Many scientists attend conferences to share their research.
words.ex_cn: 许多科学家参加大型会议来分享他们的研究。
words.en: A conference is a formal meeting where people gather to discuss matters of common interest, often over several days.

words.tr: adv. 无论如何；不管怎样
words.ex: I don't like it, but I'll do it anyhow.
words.ex_cn: 我不喜欢它，但我还是会做。
words.en: in whatever way or manner; regardless of how

words.ex: He gave an affirmative answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了肯定的回答。
words.en: An affirmative word or gesture indicates agreement or consent.

words.ex: The computer restarts after the update.
words.ex_cn: 更新后，电脑重新启动。
words.en: Begins again.

words.tr:
v. 称赞；恭维
n. 称赞；恭维
words.ex: He gave her a compliment on her dress.
words.ex_cn: 他夸了她的裙子。
words.en: A compliment is a polite expression of praise or admiration.

words.ex: Marcia walks to school every morning.
words.ex_cn: 玛西亚每天早上走路去上学。
words.en: A female given name, often associated with a person or character.

words.tr: n. （捕猎野兽用的）陷阱( pitfall的名词复数 ); 意想不到的困难，易犯的错误
words.ex: The hunters set pitfalls to catch wild animals.
words.ex_cn: 猎人们设置了陷阱来捕捉野生动物。
words.en: A pitfall is a likely mistake or problem in a situation.

words.ex: The hikers walked on a rugged trail.
words.ex_cn: 徒步者走在一条崎岖的小路上。
words.en: A rugged area of land is uneven and covered with rocks, with few trees or plants.

words.ex: His handsomeness made everyone smile.
words.ex_cn: 他的英俊让每个人都笑了。
words.en: The quality of being good-looking, especially in a man.

words.ex: He was born in the nineteenth century.
words.ex_cn: 他出生在第十九世纪。
words.en: The nineteenth item in a series is the one that you count as number nineteen.

words.ex: The teacher announces the test date tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 老师宣布明天考试。
words.en: To make a public or formal statement about a fact, occurrence, or intention.

words.tr: v. 吐；“spit”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The cat spat out the pill.
words.ex_cn: 猫把药丸吐了出来。
words.en: A spat is a short, usually minor, argument or disagreement.

words.ex: She helped her friend selflessly.
words.ex_cn: 她无私地帮助了她的朋友。
words.en: If you say that someone is selfless, you approve of them because they care about other people more than themselves.

words.tr: v. （内燃机等）发生逆火( backfire的现在分词 ); 发生回火; （枪炮）向后爆发; 发生
words.ex: The car engine started backfiring loudly.
words.ex_cn: 汽车发动机开始大声回火。
words.en: If a plan or project backfires, it has the opposite result to the one that was intended.

words.ex: He looked incredulous when he heard the news.
words.ex_cn: 当他听到这个消息时，他一脸难以置信。
words.en: If someone is incredulous, they are unable to believe something because it is very surprising or shocking.

words.tr:
adj. 了解的；熟悉的
v. 使熟悉；使相识；“acquaint”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: He is acquainted with basic math.
words.ex_cn: 他熟悉基础数学。
words.en: If you are acquainted with someone, you know them slightly.

words.ex: The machine operates smoothly.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器运行顺畅。
words.en: If you operate a business or organization, you manage it and make it work. If a machine or system operates in a particular way, it works in that way. If a doctor operates on a patient, they perform a surgical operation on them.

words.ex: The car has four wheels.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车有四个轮子。
words.en: Circular objects that revolve on an axle and are fixed below vehicles to enable them to move over the ground.

words.tr: n. 戴在头上的耳机或听筒
words.ex: He wears a headset to listen to music.
words.ex_cn: 他戴着耳机听音乐。
words.en: A headset is a pair of headphones, especially one with a microphone attached.

words.ex: The controller turns the machine on and off.
words.ex_cn: 控制者打开和关闭机器。
words.en: A controller is a device or mechanism that manages or regulates the operation of a machine or system.

words.tr: v. 发展；发育；“develop”的现在分词； adj. 发展中的；
words.ex: The country is developing its economy.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家正在发展它的经济。
words.en: A developing country or area of the world is poorer and has less advanced industries, especially in Africa, Latin America, or Asia.

words.tr:
v. 保证；确保；
n. 保证；保证书；
words.ex: The store guarantees a refund if you are not happy.
words.ex_cn: 如果你不满意，商店保证退款。
words.en: A guarantee is a formal promise that certain conditions will be fulfilled, especially that a product will be repaired or replaced if it is not of a specified quality.

words.ex: His presence made everyone feel calm.
words.ex_cn: 他的存在让每个人都感到平静。
words.en: The state or fact of existing, occurring, or being present in a place or thing.

words.ex: He called the insulter a liar.
words.ex_cn: 他称那个侮辱者是个骗子。
words.en: A person who insults or speaks disrespectfully to others.

words.tr: n. 傻瓜；傀儡；愚人（复数形式）
words.ex: The stooges laughed at the silly joke.
words.ex_cn: 这些傻瓜笑了这个愚蠢的笑话。
words.en: A group of three performers who often play the roles of incompetent assistants or victims of slapstick comedy.

words.tr: n. 编剧们；剧本作家们
words.ex: The scriptwriters wrote a funny movie.
words.ex_cn: 编剧们写了一部有趣的电影。
words.en: Writers who create scripts for films, television, or theatre productions.

words.tr: n. 表示“ph”的音素；字母组合“ph”
words.ex: The 'ph' in 'phone' is pronounced as 'f'.
words.ex_cn: 在‘phone’中的‘ph’发音为‘f’。
words.en: The symbol for pH, a measure of the acidity or alkalinity of a solution on a scale from 0 to 14.

words.tr:
adj. 结束的；结论的
v. 推断出；得出结论；结束；“conclude”的现在分词
words.ex: The concluding chapter summarized the entire book.
words.ex_cn: 最后一章总结了整本书的内容。
words.en: If you say that something is concluding, you mean it is the last part of a process, event, or piece of writing.

words.ex: He will flee from the burning house.
words.ex_cn: 他会从着火的房子里逃走。
words.en: If you flee from something or someone, you leave them quickly because you are afraid of them or because you do not want to be involved with them.

words.tr: n. 切割机；裁剪者（slitter的复数形式）
words.ex: The workers use slitters to cut the metal sheets.
words.ex_cn: 工人用分切机来切割金属板。
words.en: People who cut or slit materials, such as fabric or paper, often in an industrial or manufacturing context.

words.tr: n. 线圈; 镀锡卷板，卷带马口铁; （一）卷( coil的名词复数 ); 盘卷之物; 一圈（绳索、
words.ex: The wire forms tight coils around the magnet.
words.ex_cn: 电线围绕磁铁卷成紧密的线圈。
words.en: Coils are lengths of something wound in a joined sequence of loops, or the act of winding something in such a way.

words.ex: The night was clear, and the starlight shone brightly.
words.ex_cn: 夜晚晴朗，星光灿烂。
words.en: The light that comes from the stars.

words.tr: n. 卡布奇诺（cappuccino 的复数形式）
words.ex: He drinks two cappuccinos every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上喝两杯卡布奇诺。
words.en: A type of coffee drink made with espresso and steamed milk, often topped with a layer of foam.

words.ex: He knowingly broke the rules.
words.ex_cn: 他有意地违反了规则。
words.en: If you do something knowingly, you do it in a way that shows you understand what is happening or what the situation is.

words.tr: adj. 自鸣得意的；沾沾自喜的
words.ex: He smiled in a smug way after winning the game.
words.ex_cn: 他在赢得比赛后得意地笑了。
words.en: If you say that someone is smug, you are criticizing the fact they seem very pleased with how good, clever, or lucky they are.

words.ex: The bridge has a stone arch.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥有一个石拱。
words.en: An arch is a structure that is curved at the top and is usually made of stone or brick. Arches are often used to support the weight of a bridge or the roof of a building.

words.tr: v. 弯曲；使弯曲；n. 弯曲；弹性
words.ex: He flexes his arm to show his strength.
words.ex_cn: 他弯曲手臂来展示力量。
words.en: To bend or cause to bend; the act of bending or the ability to bend.

words.tr: n. （非正式）婴儿；小宝宝（常用于口语或昵称）
words.ex: The baby is sleeping in the crib.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿正在婴儿床里睡觉。
words.en: A term for a foolish or contemptible person; often used informally to express annoyance or disdain.

words.tr: n. （人名）劳尔（Lauer 是一个姓氏，常见于德语国家）
words.ex: He is a lauer who cleans the floor every day.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名清洁工，每天打扫地板。
words.en: A surname or a rare term, possibly referring to a person or a specific place name.

words.ex: He showed me his photographs from the trip.
words.ex_cn: 他给我看了他旅行时拍的照片。
words.en: A photograph is a picture made using a camera, in which an image is focused onto film or other light-sensitive material and then made visible and permanent by chemical treatment, or stored digitally.

words.ex: The flowers were interspersed with grass.
words.ex_cn: 花朵夹杂在草丛中。
words.en: If one thing is interspersed with another, it has the other thing distributed among it at intervals.

words.tr: int. 表示惊讶或恐惧的感叹词
words.ex: Eek! A mouse!
words.ex_cn: int. 哎呀！一只老鼠！
words.en: used to express surprise or fear

words.ex: He understands difficult situations easily.
words.ex_cn: 他很容易理解复杂的情况。
words.en: Situations refer to the set of circumstances in which one finds oneself; a state of affairs.

words.ex: Morgan is my best friend.
words.ex_cn: 摩根是我最好的朋友。
words.en: A surname, or a reference to J.P. Morgan, the American financier and banker.

words.tr:
adj. 僻静的；隐僻的； 退隐的
v. 隔离；隔绝；隐居；“seclude”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: The cabin is secluded in the woods.
words.ex_cn: 小木屋坐落在树林中，十分僻静。
words.en: A secluded place is quiet, private, and not near people or things that disturb you.

words.ex: Long hours of work tire him.
words.ex_cn: 长时间的工作让他感到疲倦。
words.en: If something tires you or if you tire, you feel that you have used a lot of energy and you want to rest or sleep.

words.ex: Loud noises upsets her.
words.ex_cn: 嘈杂的声音让她感到苦恼。
words.en: Causes emotional distress or disturbance.

words.tr: n. 无意义的事物；琐事
words.ex: She whispered sweet nothings into his ear.
words.ex_cn: 她在他耳边轻声说着甜言蜜语。
words.en: Nothings are things that are considered unimportant or trivial.

words.tr: n. 恶棍( villain的名词复数 ); 罪犯; （小说、戏剧等中的）反面人物; 淘气鬼
words.ex: The villains in the play were easily recognizable.
words.ex_cn: 剧中的反面人物很容易辨认。
words.en: A villain is someone who deliberately harms other people or breaks the law in order to get what he or she wants.

words.ex: The government is taking action to combat terrorists.
words.ex_cn: 政府正在采取行动打击恐怖分子。
words.en: Terrorists are individuals or groups that use violence and intimidation, especially against civilians, in the pursuit of political aims.

words.ex: The russians are playing chess in the park.
words.ex_cn: 俄罗斯人在公园里下棋。
words.en: Plural noun referring to people from Russia.

words.tr: n. 设施；特色功能；特定场所；资质；
words.ex: The school has a new sports facility.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校有一个新的体育设施。
words.en: A facility is a place, building, or service that is designed for a particular purpose.

words.tr: n. 取消；撤销；作废；中止；
words.ex: The flight cancellation made us wait for a new ticket.
words.ex_cn: 航班取消让我们不得不等待新的机票。
words.en: The act of cancelling something; a situation in which something that has been arranged is stopped from happening.

words.ex: He picked up a brochure about the city.
words.ex_cn: 他拿了一本关于这座城市的宣传小册子。
words.en: A brochure is a type of small magazine or booklet containing pictures and information about something or advertising something.

words.ex: She wears many necklaces every day.
words.ex_cn: 她每天都戴很多条项链。
words.en: A necklace is a piece of jewellery such as a chain or a string of beads which someone, usually a woman, wears around their neck.

words.ex: He is going to marry his fiancée next month.
words.ex_cn: 他下个月要和未婚妻结婚。
words.en: A woman who is engaged to be married.

words.tr: n. 珠宝商；钟表匠；宝石匠；珠宝店
words.ex: The jeweler fixed her broken necklace.
words.ex_cn: 珠宝商修好了她损坏的项链。
words.en: A jeweler is a person who makes, sells, or repairs jewelry and watches.

words.ex: The jewelers crafted a beautiful necklace for the queen.
words.ex_cn: 珠宝商为女王制作了一条漂亮的项链。
words.en: Jewelers are professionals who design, make, or sell jewelry and precious stones.

words.ex: He picked up brochures at the tourist center.
words.ex_cn: 他在游客中心拿了一些小册子。
words.en: A brochure is a thin book with pictures and information, usually advertising something.

words.tr: v. 闲逛；蹭吃蹭喝；懒散地游荡
words.ex: He is mooching around the house without doing anything.
words.ex_cn: 他无所事事地在房子里闲逛。
words.en: The act of obtaining something, such as money or goods, by taking advantage of others' generosity or without paying.

words.ex: She wears sapphires on her necklace.
words.ex_cn: 她戴着蓝宝石项链。
words.en: Precious blue gemstones, a variety of the mineral corundum, valued in jewellery.

words.tr: n. 克拉（宝石重量单位）；开（含纯金的量）
words.ex: The diamond weighs two carats.
words.ex_cn: 这颗钻石重两克拉。
words.en: A unit of weight for precious stones and pearls, equivalent to 200 milligrams.

words.tr: adj. 十拿九稳的；绝对有效的
words.ex: This is a surefire way to pass the test.
words.ex_cn: 这是通过考试的绝对可靠方法。
words.en: Certain to succeed; guaranteed to work or be effective.

words.tr: v. 一瞥； adj. 一瞥( glance的现在分词 )；
words.ex: He was glancing at his watch.
words.ex_cn: 他瞥了一眼手表。
words.en: If something is glancing, it is done quickly and not directly, or it hits something at an angle rather than directly.

words.tr: n. 冲浪运动员；冲浪者
words.ex: He is a surfer who rides waves every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他是个冲浪者，每天早上都去冲浪。
words.en: A surfer is someone who rides on waves using a surfboard, especially as a sport or hobby.

words.tr: v. 使不知所措；使无法解决；击败；压垮；淹没
words.ex: The homework overwhelms her every night.
words.ex_cn: 每天晚上的作业让她感到不堪重负。
words.en: To overwhelm means to bury or drown beneath a huge mass of something, or to defeat someone completely.

words.ex: The gates open at 8 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 大门早上8点开放。
words.en: The movable barrier that is used to close an entrance, typically consisting of a frame that swings on hinges or that slides or rolls.

words.tr: n. 崩溃；故障；细目分类；
words.ex: The stress led to a breakdown.
words.ex_cn: 压力导致了崩溃。
words.en: A breakdown is a failure of a system, machine, or relationship, or a sudden collapse in someone's mental health.

words.ex: The smoke began to stifle her breathing.
words.ex_cn: 烟雾开始让她窒息。
words.en: To stifle something means to prevent it from happening, continuing, or developing.

words.ex: The army has new weaponry.
words.ex_cn: 军队有新的武器装备。
words.en: Weaponry refers to weapons in general or the weapons that are available to a country or group.

words.tr: v. 关在笼中；囚禁（cage 的现在分词）
words.ex: He is caging the birds to keep them safe.
words.ex_cn: 他正在把鸟关在笼子里以保护它们。
words.en: Placing someone or something in a cage; restricting freedom or movement.

words.ex: The princess wore a shiny tiara at the ball.
words.ex_cn: 公主在舞会上戴着一顶闪亮的王冠。
words.en: A tiara is a jeweled, ornamental crown traditionally worn by women on formal occasions.

words.ex: The soldier fired a musket in the battle.
words.ex_cn: 士兵在战斗中开了一支火绳枪。
words.en: A musket is an old-fashioned type of gun which was used before rifles were invented.

words.ex: He lives in the nether world of dreams.
words.ex_cn: 他生活在梦境的地下世界。
words.en: Situated or occurring below or beneath something else.

words.ex: The storm unleashed heavy rain.
words.ex_cn: 风暴释放出大雨。
words.en: If you say that someone or something unleashes a powerful force, feeling, activity, or group, you mean that they suddenly start it or send it to move somewhere.

words.tr: adj. 压倒的；无法抗拒的；势不可挡的； v. “overwhelm”的现在分词；
words.ex: The crowd's cheers were overwhelming.
words.ex_cn: 人群的欢呼声压倒了一切。
words.en: If something is overwhelming, it affects you very strongly, and you do not know how to deal with it.

words.tr: n. 沙龙（人名，常见女性名）
words.ex: Sharon walks to school every morning.
words.ex_cn: 莎伦每天早上步行去学校。
words.en: A female given name, of Hebrew origin meaning 'forest' or 'beautiful'.

words.ex: He is solving a math problem.
words.ex_cn: 他正在解决一个数学问题。
words.en: To find an answer to a problem or to deal with a difficult situation.

words.ex: He will surrender when he sees the police.
words.ex_cn: 当他看到警察时，他会投降。
words.en: If you surrender, you stop fighting or resisting someone and agree that you have been beaten.

words.tr: adj. 对立的； v. 反对；“oppose”的现在分词；
words.ex: The two teams have opposing views on the rule change.
words.ex_cn: 这两支队伍对规则修改持有对立的观点。
words.en: If you are opposing someone or something, you are competing against them or trying to prevent them from doing something.

words.ex: The mediator helped the two sides reach an agreement.
words.ex_cn: 调解人帮助双方达成了协议。
words.en: A mediator is a person who tries to end a disagreement by helping the two sides to talk about and agree on a solution.

words.tr: n. 阵营（指观点相同且与持不同观点者对立的集团）；兵营；营地( camp的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The two camps argued loudly about the new law.
words.ex_cn: 两个阵营就新法律激烈争论。
words.en: A camp is a place where people live temporarily in tents or other temporary structures.

words.ex: The police will examine the crime scene.
words.ex_cn: 警察将调查犯罪现场。
words.en: If you examine something, you look at it carefully.

words.tr: n. （非标准用法）指 stub 的现在分词形式，常用于口语中表示‘截短’或‘切断’，但标准英语中应使用 'stubbing'
words.ex: He is stubing his toe on the chair.
words.ex_cn: 他把脚趾撞在椅子上了。
words.en: A misspelling or variant of 'stumbing,' meaning to trip or lose balance while walking.

words.ex: This smoothie is a tasty mix of fruits and yogurt.
words.ex_cn: 这种奶昔是水果和酸奶的美味混合。
words.en: To combine two or more substances so that they become a single substance; a combination of different qualities, things, or emotions.

words.ex: Thompson is a scientist who studies climate change.
words.ex_cn: 汤普森是一位研究气候变化的科学家。
words.en: A common surname; also a town in New Zealand.

words.tr: v. 手持着使用（武器、工具等）；手持着使用（武器、工具等）( wield的现在分词 )；
words.ex: He was wielding a hammer to fix the table.
words.ex_cn: 他正手持锤子修理桌子。
words.en: To wield something means to hold and use it, especially as a weapon or tool. It can also mean to have and be able to use power or influence.

words.tr: adj. 令人恐惧的；使人惊骇的；可怕的； v. “horrify”的现在分词；
words.ex: The accident scene was horrifying.
