words.ex: He sat with good posture at the desk.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在书桌前，姿势端正。
words.en: Your posture is the way in which you hold your body when you are standing or sitting.

words.ex: He reached manhood at the age of eighteen.
words.ex_cn: 他十八岁时成年。
words.en: Manhood refers to the state or period of being a man, especially an adult man, and can also denote the qualities traditionally associated with men, such as strength and courage.

words.tr: n. 一绺头发；发辫；卷发；枝条; vt. 把（头发）梳理成绺; n. （Tress）人名；（英、意...
words.ex: The wind blew through the tress.
words.ex_cn: 风穿过树木吹过。
words.en: A lock or a braid of hair.

words.tr: abbr. 请回复；“please reply”的缩写
words.ex: Please rsvp by Friday.
words.ex_cn: 请在周五前回复。
words.en: RSVP is a request for a response from the invited person or people, used at the end of invitations. It stands for 'Répondez s'il vous plaît', which is French for 'Please reply'.

words.ex: The room has five bright bulbs.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间有五盏明亮的白炽灯。
words.en: Bulbs are the round parts of some plants that are planted in the ground and from which new plants grow. They are also the glass part of an electric lamp, which gives out light when electricity passes through it.

words.tr: n. 男性；男子气概；阳性
words.ex: He shows traditional masculinity by being strong and quiet.
words.ex_cn: 他通过坚强和沉默展现男性气质。
words.en: The quality or condition of being masculine; manliness.

words.tr: n. [图情]摘要（brief 的复数）；三角裤；贴身的短内裤; v. 作……的摘要（brief 的...
words.ex: He wears briefs every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都穿内裤。
words.en: Briefs are short underpants for men or women. In a legal context, a brief is a written summary of the facts and legal points supporting one side of a case, prepared for a court appearance.

words.ex: He dared to speak the truth.
words.ex_cn: 他敢说出真相。
words.en: To have the courage to do something.

words.tr: v. 旅游；旅行；“travel”的现在分词； n. 旅行；旅游；游历； adj. 旅行的；巡回的；旅行用的；
words.ex: I love traveling to new countries.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢去新的国家旅游。
words.en: Moving or going from one place to another, especially over a long distance.

words.ex: He was born under the sign of Aquarius.
words.ex_cn: 他出生在水瓶座。
words.en: A zodiac sign (January 20 – February 18) represented by a water-bearer.

words.tr: adj. 再次发生的；再次兴起的；更新的； v. 更新；“renew”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The conflict was renewed after the peace talks failed.
words.ex_cn: 和平谈判失败后，冲突再次发生。
words.en: If something is renewed, it is made new again or replaced so that it is like new.

words.tr: n. 保时捷（德国著名汽车品牌）
words.ex: He drives a red porsche.
words.ex_cn: 他开一辆红色的保时捷。
words.en: Porsche is a German automobile manufacturer specializing in high-performance sports cars, SUVs, and sedans.

words.tr: n. 双子座（黄道十二宫之一）；双胞胎之一
words.ex: He was born under the sign of Gemini.
words.ex_cn: 他出生在双子座。
words.en: In astrology, Gemini is the third sign of the zodiac, symbolized by the twins, and is associated with people born between May 21 and June 20. Geminis are often characterized as adaptable, versatile, and communicative.

words.tr: n. 蜂窝；蜂箱；嘈杂的场所
words.ex: The bees live in a beehive near the garden.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂住在花园附近的一个蜂箱里。
words.en: A beehive is a structure in which bees are kept, which is designed to protect them from the weather and predators, and to provide them with a place to store honey.

words.ex: The wipers on my car are not working properly.
words.ex_cn: n. 我车上的雨刷工作不正常。
words.en: Devices used to wipe rain or other liquids from the windshield of a vehicle.

words.ex: He was born under the sign of Sagittarius.
words.ex_cn: 他出生在射手座。
words.en: A zodiac sign (November 22 – December 21) represented by an archer.

words.tr: n. 金牛座（黄道十二宫之一）；金牛宫
words.ex: He was born under the sign of Taurus.
words.ex_cn: 他出生在金牛座。
words.en: The second sign of the zodiac, symbolized by the Bull, associated with the period from approximately April 20 to May 20.

words.tr: n. 处女座；维尔格铬镍钨; n. （Virgo）人名；（英）弗戈
words.ex: She was born under the sign of Virgo.
words.ex_cn: 她出生在处女座。
words.en: Virgo is one of the constellations of the zodiac, often depicted as a maiden. It is the sixth sign of the zodiac, which the sun enters about August 23.

words.ex: He was horsing around in the yard with his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他和朋友们在院子里胡闹。
words.en: To engage in playful or boisterous behavior, often involving physical activity or mock fighting; also refers to riding a horse.

words.tr: v. 以快而平稳的速度长距离行驶； adj. 乘船巡游( cruise的现在分词 )；
words.ex: The car was cruising down the highway at 100 km/h.
words.ex_cn: 汽车以每小时100公里的快而平稳的速度在高速公路上行驶。
words.en: Travelling by boat for pleasure, often over long distances.

words.tr: n. 中士；巡佐；军士；警官
words.ex: The sergeant gave orders to the soldiers.
words.ex_cn: 军士向士兵们下达了命令。
words.en: A sergeant is a non-commissioned officer in the army or marines ranking above a corporal and below a lieutenant, or a police officer ranking below an inspector.

words.tr:
int. 阿门
n. 认可；赞同
words.ex: The priest concluded the prayer with 'Amen.'
words.ex_cn: 牧师以“阿门”结束了祈祷。
words.en: used at the end of a prayer or hymn, meaning 'so be it'

words.tr:
n. （赞美上帝用语）哈利路亚 
int. 哈利路亚（表示赞美或欢乐）
words.ex: The choir sang a beautiful hallelujah chorus.
words.ex_cn: 唱诗班唱了一首优美的哈利路亚合唱曲。
words.en: An exclamation of praise, joy, or thanks to God.

words.ex: Tom and Jerry scored 80 and 90 points, respectively.
words.ex_cn: 汤姆和杰里分别得了80分和90分。
words.en: Respectively is used to indicate that the items in a list correspond to the items in another list in the same order.

words.ex: The rope loosens when you pull it gently.
words.ex_cn: 当你轻轻拉绳子时，它会变松。
words.en: Makes something less tight or firm; becomes less tight or firm.

words.tr: v. （酒杯等）发出清脆的碰撞声；叮当响（第三人称单数）
words.ex: The glasses clinks when they toast.
words.ex_cn: 当他们碰杯时，玻璃杯发出叮当声。
words.en: Makes a light, sharp, ringing sound, like that of small metal objects touching.

words.ex: The player thrusts the sword forward quickly.
words.ex_cn: 那个玩家迅速地向前刺出剑。
words.en: To push something or someone suddenly or violently in a specified direction.

words.tr:
n. 支撑物；支柱；道具
v. 支撑；靠
words.ex: He uses a prop to support the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 他用一个道具来支撑架子。
words.en: A prop is an object or piece of furniture that is used in a play or film to make a scene look more realistic, or something that is used to support or hold up another object.

words.tr: n. 小袋；囊状袋；育儿袋；
words.ex: The kangaroo carries its baby in a pouch.
words.ex_cn: 袋鼠把幼崽放在小袋里。
words.en: A pouch is a small, flexible bag, typically made of leather or fabric, used for carrying small items.

words.ex: The children are playing violins in the school orchestra.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在学校管弦乐队中演奏小提琴。
words.en: Violins are bowed string instruments with four strings tuned in perfect fifths. They are the smallest and highest-pitched instruments in the violin family, which also includes the viola, cello, and double bass.

words.ex: The knights carried sharp swords.
words.ex_cn: 骑士们带着锋利的剑。
words.en: A sword is a weapon with a long metal blade and a hilt with a handguard, used for thrusting or striking.

words.tr: n. 报告； v. 报告；报道；“report”的现在分词；
words.ex: The reporting of the accident was very clear.
words.ex_cn: 这起事故的报告非常清晰。
words.en: The act of giving a spoken or written account of something that one has observed, heard, done, or investigated.

words.ex: The jumper cleared the bar with ease.
words.ex_cn: 这位跳高运动员轻松越过了横杆。
words.en: A jumper is a piece of clothing that is worn on the upper part of the body and has long sleeves. It is typically made of wool or a similar material and is designed to keep the wearer warm.

words.ex: Family bonds keep us close together.
words.ex_cn: 家庭纽带让我们紧密相连。
words.en: Bonds are fixed-income securities that represent a loan made by an investor to a borrower (typically corporate or governmental).

words.ex: Her beloved dog always greeted her at the door.
words.ex_cn: 她钟爱的狗总是在门口迎接她。
words.en: Dearly loved.

words.tr: n. 触摸者；（法语借词，常用于击剑中指轻触得分的动作）
words.ex: The toucher is not working on the screen.
words.ex_cn: 这个触摸器在屏幕上不工作。
words.en: A person who touches or feels something, often used in a specific context like art or sensory experiences.

words.ex: The Nazis were responsible for many atrocities during World War II.
words.ex_cn: 纳粹党在第二次世界大战期间犯下了许多暴行。
words.en: Nazis were members of the National Socialist German Workers' Party, which was led by Adolf Hitler and controlled Germany from 1933 to 1945.

words.tr: n. 地狱般的地方；极其恶劣的环境
words.ex: The prison was described as a hellhole by the inmates.
words.ex_cn: n. 囚犯们描述这座监狱是个地狱般的地方。
words.en: A hellhole is a place or situation that is extremely unpleasant, uncomfortable, or dangerous.

words.ex: He reads Shakespeare in English class.
words.ex_cn: 他在英语课上读莎士比亚的作品。
words.en: Shakespeare refers to William Shakespeare, an English playwright and poet, widely regarded as one of the greatest writers in the English language and the world's pre-eminent dramatist.

words.ex: The platoon was deployed to the front line.
words.ex_cn: 该排被部署到前线。
words.en: A platoon is a military unit typically consisting of two or more squads, sections, or patrols. It is usually commanded by a lieutenant and is part of a company.

words.ex: Oscar won a prize for his painting.
words.ex_cn: 奥斯卡因他的画作获奖了。
words.en: An Oscar is an award given by the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences for excellence in cinematic achievements.

words.ex: The soldiers marched in a line.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们列队行进。
words.en: A soldier is a person who serves in an army.

words.tr:
adj. 法定的；既定的
v. 授予；使穿衣；“vest”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: He has a vested right to the property.
words.ex_cn: 他对该财产拥有法定权利。
words.en: Past participle of vest: legally granted or secured, especially a right or interest.

words.ex: Rita is my best friend.
words.ex_cn: 丽塔是我最好的朋友。
words.en: Rita is a female given name, often used in English-speaking countries.

words.ex: A crow sat on the tree branch.
words.ex_cn: 一只乌鸦坐在树枝上。
words.en: A crow is a large black bird which makes a loud, harsh noise. If someone crows, they talk in a very proud way about something they have done or achieved.

words.tr:
n. 伪装；伪装物；
v. 伪装；掩饰；
words.ex: He wore a hat and glasses as a disguise.
words.ex_cn: 他戴了帽子和眼镜作为伪装。
words.en: To disguise means to change your appearance or behavior so that people will not recognize you, or to make something seem different from what it really is.

words.ex: The birds flew home at dusk.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿在黄昏时飞回家。
words.en: Dusk is the time just before night when the daylight has almost gone but when it is not completely dark.

words.tr: n. (化学元素) 砷（As）的旧称；(语言学) 一种辅音音素
words.ex: He is learning algebra this year.
words.ex_cn: 他今年在学习代数。
words.en: A misspelling or non-standard spelling of 'test', which is not a recognized English word.

words.ex: The floor is slippery after it rains.
words.ex_cn: 下雨后地板很滑。
words.en: Something that is slippery is smooth, wet, or oily and is therefore difficult to walk on or to hold.

words.tr: v. 安排；“arrange”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 安排的；
words.ex: They arranged a meeting for tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他们安排了明天的会议。
words.en: If you arrange an event or meeting, you make plans for it to happen.

words.tr: v. （清楚地）发音；清楚地表明；阐明
words.ex: He tries to enunciate each word clearly.
words.ex_cn: 他努力清晰地发出每个单词的音。
words.en: To enunciate means to pronounce words clearly and distinctly, or to state something clearly and in detail.

words.ex: The annunciation of the new law caused a lot of discussions among the citizens.
words.ex_cn: 新法律的公布在市民中引起了许多讨论。
words.en: The act of announcing something.

words.tr: n. 罐头；锡罐（tin 的复数形式）
words.ex: He bought three tins of beans at the store.
words.ex_cn: 他在商店买了三罐豆子。
words.en: Small, thin pieces of metal used for preserving food in sealed containers.

words.tr: n. 索菲（女性名，Pauline的变体）
words.ex: Paulette walks to school every morning.
words.ex_cn: 波莱特每天早上走路去上学。
words.en: A female given name, often used as a term for a specific person or character.

words.ex: He was doubly rewarded for his efforts.
words.ex_cn: 他的努力得到了双倍的回报。
words.en: To a double degree; twice as much.

words.ex: The cats sleep in the shades under the tree.
words.ex_cn: 猫在树下的阴凉处睡觉。
words.en: Shades refer to the darkness or coolness caused by the blocking of direct sunlight, or the different degrees of lightness or darkness of a color.

words.ex: He felt unhappiness after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业后感到不快乐。
words.en: The feeling of not being happy or satisfied.

words.ex: He follows the orthodox religious practices.
words.ex_cn: 他遵循正统的宗教习俗。
words.en: Orthodox beliefs, methods, or systems are ones which are accepted or used by most people.

words.ex: She dearly loves her little brother.
words.ex_cn: 她深深地爱着她的弟弟。
words.en: If you love someone dearly, you love them very much.

words.ex: She lives in Sweden.
words.ex_cn: 她住在瑞典。
words.en: Sweden is a Nordic country in Northern Europe known for its welfare state, high standard of living, and beautiful natural landscapes.

words.ex: He went to the local clinics for a check-up.
words.ex_cn: 他去当地的诊所做检查。
words.en: Clinics are places where people receive medical treatment or advice, especially when they do not stay overnight. They can also refer to the practical instruction in a particular field, especially in medicine.

words.ex: The outcome of the game was a tie.
words.ex_cn: 比赛的结果是平局。
words.en: The outcome of an activity, process, or situation is the situation that exists at the end of it.

words.ex: The bandleader orchestrated the performance with precision.
words.ex_cn: 乐队领队精准地指挥了这场表演。
words.en: A bandleader is the leader of a band, especially a dance band or jazz band, who typically directs the group's performance and may also play an instrument.

words.ex: He is clumsy and dropped the glass.
words.ex_cn: 他很笨拙，把玻璃杯打翻了。
words.en: A clumsy person moves or handles things in a careless, awkward way, often so that things are knocked over or broken.

words.tr: adj. 令人高兴的； v. “please”的现在分词；
words.ex: The pleasing smell of cookies made her smile.
words.ex_cn: 饼干令人高兴的香味让她笑了。
words.en: Something that is pleasing gives you pleasure or satisfaction.

words.tr: n. 方言；土语；方言，土语( dialect的名词复数 )；
words.ex: People in different villages speak different dialects.
words.ex_cn: 不同村庄的人说不同的方言。
words.en: Varieties of a language spoken in a particular region or by a particular group.

words.tr:
v. 防止；战斗；抑制；
n. 战斗；
words.ex: The new law aims to combat pollution.
words.ex_cn: 这项新法律旨在防止污染。
words.en: Combat refers to fighting, especially during a war. It can also mean to try to stop something harmful from happening or increasing.

words.ex: Her eyelids were heavy after the long day.
words.ex_cn: 漫长的一天后，她的眼皮很重。
words.en: The movable folds of skin and muscle that can be closed over the eyeballs.

words.ex: She admired his courage.
words.ex_cn: 她钦佩他的勇气。
words.en: To regard with respect or warm approval.

words.tr: n. 梅林达（女子名，来源于古英语，意为‘温柔的’或‘可爱的’）
words.ex: Melinda walks to school every morning.
words.ex_cn: 梅琳达每天早上走路去上学。
words.en: A common female given name.

words.ex: He tragically lost his life in the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在事故中悲惨地失去了生命。
words.en: In a manner that is very sad, often involving death or suffering.

words.ex: The nail fits into the groove.
words.ex_cn: 钉子卡在槽里。
words.en: A groove is a long, narrow space or cut in a surface, often made to guide the movement of something or to hold something in place. It can also refer to a settled routine or way of doing things that is hard to change.

words.ex: He made a sneaky move to take the cookie without being seen.
words.ex_cn: 他偷偷摸摸地拿走了饼干，没被人发现。
words.en: If you describe someone as sneaky, you disapprove of them because they do things secretly rather than openly.

words.tr: n. 模样；面貌；方面；朝向；“aspect”的复数；
words.ex: The aspects of the old house still look charming.
words.ex_cn: 这所老房子的外貌仍然很迷人。
words.en: a particular part or feature of something

words.tr: n. 花鳉，胎鳉；胎鳉科，胎鳉属；懦夫；娘娘腔的男人; n. （Molly）（美）茉莉（人名）
words.ex: The molly swims in the aquarium with other small fish.
words.ex_cn: 花鳉在水族箱里和其他小鱼一起游动。
words.en: A small, brightly colored tropical fish often kept in aquariums; also a female given name.

words.tr: n. 吉伯（磁通量的单位）
words.ex: Gilbert is walking to school.
words.ex_cn: 吉尔伯特正走向学校。
words.en: A unit of magnetomotive force in the centimeter-gram-second system, equal to the magnetomotive force of a closed loop of one turn in which there is a current of 1/(4π) abamperes.

words.tr: v. <讳>放屁( fart的现在分词 )
words.ex: He couldn't stop farting after eating the beans.
words.ex_cn: 吃了豆子后，他不停地放屁。
words.en: The act of expelling intestinal gas through the anus.

words.tr: n. [微]菌株；[微]菌株（strain 复数）； v. 使过度劳累；
words.ex: These strains of bacteria can survive in extreme temperatures.
words.ex_cn: 这些菌株能在极端温度下生存。
words.en: If strain is put on an organization or system, it has to do more than it is able to do.

words.tr: adj. 误导的； v. “mislead”的现在分词；
words.ex: The ad is misleading because it shows fake results.
words.ex_cn: 这个广告是误导的，因为它展示了虚假的结果。
words.en: If you describe something as misleading, you mean that it gives you a wrong idea or impression.

words.ex: Mona is painting a beautiful picture.
words.ex_cn: 莫娜正在画一幅美丽的画。
words.en: Mona is a female given name, often used in various cultures.

words.ex: The children built a mound of sand at the beach.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在海滩上堆了一个沙土墩。
words.en: A mound is a large pile of earth or stones; it can also refer to the action of piling up earth or stones.

words.tr:
v. 吹气；喘气；发怒
n. 气恼；愤怒
words.ex: He huffed when he was angry.
words.ex_cn: 他生气时会喘气。
words.en: If someone huffs, they express their annoyance or irritation in a noisy way, often by breathing out noisily through their nose.

words.tr:
n. 洗发水；洗发精；洗发香波；“shampoo”的复数
v. 洗头发；“shampoo”的第三人称单数
words.ex: He shampoos his hair every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上洗头发。
words.en: Liquid or foam preparations used for washing and cleaning hair.

words.ex: He used a disposable cup for his coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他用了一次性杯子喝咖啡。
words.en: Something that is disposable is intended to be thrown away after use.

words.ex: Adams is a teacher at the local school.
words.ex_cn: 亚当斯是当地一所学校的老师。
words.en: A common surname, often referring to a person, place, or entity with that name.

words.ex: She was heartbroken after the breakup.
words.ex_cn: 分手后她心碎了。
words.en: If someone is heartbroken, they are extremely sad about something that has happened to them.

words.ex: The uptake of nutrients by plants is important for growth.
words.ex_cn: 植物对营养物质的摄取对生长很重要。
words.en: The process by which substances are taken into a cell, organism, or system; the understanding or comprehension of information.

words.tr: adv. 谨慎地；小心地；机警地
words.ex: He looked warily at the stranger.
words.ex_cn: 他警惕地看着那个陌生人。
words.en: In a way that shows caution about possible dangers or problems.

words.tr: n. 聚集日光引火的凸透镜，太阳眼镜
words.ex: He wears sunglasses to protect his eyes from the bright sun.
words.ex_cn: 他戴太阳镜来保护眼睛免受强烈阳光的伤害。
words.en: Sunglasses are glasses with dark lenses that you wear to protect your eyes from bright sunlight.

words.tr: n. 摇动器；混合器；搅拌机
words.ex: He uses a shaker to mix his protein drink.
words.ex_cn: 他用摇壶来混合他的蛋白饮料。
words.en: A shaker is a container used for mixing ingredients by shaking, often used in making cocktails.

words.ex: The magnet shows strong magnetism.
words.ex_cn: 这个磁铁显示出很强的磁性。
words.en: Magnetism is a physical phenomenon produced by the motion of electric charge, resulting in attractive and repulsive forces between objects.

words.tr: adj. 无痛苦的；不痛的；无需努力（工作）的
words.ex: The injection was painless.
words.ex_cn: 这次注射没有疼痛。
words.en: If you describe something as painless, you mean that it is easy to do or causes you no trouble or suffering.

words.ex: He formally accepted the award at the ceremony.
words.ex_cn: 他在仪式上正式接受了奖项。
words.en: in a formal manner

words.tr: adj. 南斯拉夫的；南斯拉夫人的
words.ex: He is a Yugoslavian student.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名南斯拉夫学生。
words.en: Relating to or characteristic of the former country of Yugoslavia or its people.

words.ex: Murray plays tennis every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 默里每个周末都打网球。
words.en: Murray is a surname of Scottish origin, meaning 'lord' or 'master'. It is also used as a given name.

words.tr: v. 拖，拉，拽( tow的过去式和过去分词 )
words.ex: The broken car was towed to the garage.
words.ex_cn: 那辆坏掉的车被拖到了修车厂。
words.en: Pulled or carried behind a vehicle, especially a car or truck.

words.tr: v. 打开拉链；解开拉链（第三人称单数）
words.ex: He unzips his jacket when it gets warm.
words.ex_cn: 天气变暖时，他拉开夹克拉链。
words.en: Opens something by pulling down a zipper.

words.tr: adj. 最勇敢的（brave 的最高级）
words.ex: He is the bravest man I know.
words.ex_cn: 他是我认识的最勇敢的人。
words.en: Superlative form of brave, meaning most courageous or fearless.

words.tr:
n. 斧子
v. 用斧砍；裁减；大量削减
words.ex: He chopped the wood with an ax.
words.ex_cn: 他用斧子劈木头。
words.en: An ax is a tool used for chopping wood, typically consisting of a heavy metal blade fixed at a right angle to a wooden handle. As a verb, it means to reduce or remove something, especially jobs or services, often as a cost-saving measure.

words.ex: He adjusted the stirrups before mounting the horse.
words.ex_cn: 他在上马前调整了马镫。
words.en: Stirrups are the loops or rings attached to a saddle that support a rider's feet.

words.tr:
n. 度假胜地；手段；
v. 求助于；
words.ex: They went to a beach resort for their vacation.
words.ex_cn: 他们去一个海滨度假胜地度假。
words.en: If you resort to a particular course of action, you do it because you cannot see any other way of achieving what you want.

words.tr: n. 亚特兰蒂斯（传说中的失落大陆）
words.ex: They say Atlantis sank into the sea long ago.
words.ex_cn: 据说亚特兰蒂斯很久以前沉入了大海。
words.en: Atlantis is a legendary island first mentioned in Plato's dialogues Timaeus and Critias, described as a powerful and advanced kingdom that sank into the ocean in a night and a day.

words.ex: The zoo keeper feeds the lions every morning.
words.ex_cn: 动物园饲养员每天早上喂狮子。
words.en: A keeper is someone whose job is to look after a particular place or thing.

words.ex: He adds garlic to the soup for flavor.
words.ex_cn: 他往汤里加蒜来提味。
words.en: A strong-smelling pungent-tasting bulb, used as a flavoring in cooking and in herbal medicine.

words.ex: The change in her mood was noticeable.
words.ex_cn: 她情绪的变化显而易见。
words.en: Something that is noticeable is very obvious, so that it is easy to see, hear, or recognize.

words.ex: The classroom is orderly and clean.
words.ex_cn: 教室整洁有序。
words.en: If something is done in an orderly fashion or manner, it is done in a well-organized and controlled way.

words.tr: v. 用螺丝固定；欺骗；压榨
words.ex: He was screwing the pieces of wood together.
words.ex_cn: 他正在用螺丝把木头固定在一起。
words.en: The act of fastening or tightening something with a screw; also, to cheat or exploit someone.

words.tr: n. 门框；门的框架结构
words.ex: The painting hangs on the doorframe.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画挂在门框上。
words.en: The vertical frame that surrounds a door, providing structural support and a surface for hinges and trim.

words.tr: n. 印度传统的问候方式，双手合十，微微鞠躬
words.ex: She greeted me with a warm 'namaste'.
words.ex_cn: 她用热情的'namaste'向我问候。
words.en: A traditional Indian greeting or gesture of respect, made by bringing the palms together before the face or chest and bowing.

words.tr: n. 弓；鞠躬；（船的）首部；（布料的）褶皱；v. 鞠躬；（使）弯曲；（船）首向
words.ex: The girl tied bows on her shoes.
words.ex_cn: 女孩在她的鞋子上系了蝴蝶结。
words.en: Knots or loops of ribbon, fabric, or string used for decoration or to tie things.

words.ex: My uncles come to visit every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 我的叔叔们每个星期天都来拜访。
words.en: The brother of one's father or mother or the husband of one's aunt.

words.ex: My aunts visited me last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我的阿姨们上周末来看我了。
words.en: The sister of one's father or mother; the wife of one's uncle.

words.ex: The children waited expectantly for the gifts.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们期待地等待着礼物。
words.en: In a way that shows you are hoping for something to happen or someone to arrive.

words.ex: He inhale the fresh air in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 他早上吸入新鲜空气。
words.en: To inhale means to breathe in air, smoke, or gas.

words.tr:
n. 壁画
v. 作壁画
words.ex: The artist painted a fresco on the church wall.
words.ex_cn: 这位艺术家在教堂的墙上画了一幅湿壁画。
words.en: A fresco is a picture that is painted on a plastered wall when the plaster is still wet.

words.ex: He is evidently tired after the long walk.
words.ex_cn: 他走完漫长的路后显然很累。
words.en: In a way that is clearly seen or understood; obviously.

words.ex: The consumer buys food at the store.
words.ex_cn: 消费者在商店购买食物。
words.en: A consumer is a person who buys goods or uses services.

words.ex: I got an earful from my boss for being late.
words.ex_cn: n. 我因为迟到被老板斥责了一顿。
words.en: An earful is a lot of something that you hear, especially when it is more than you wanted to hear, such as complaints or criticism.

words.ex: He filed a complaint about the noisy neighbors.
words.ex_cn: 他投诉了吵闹的邻居。
words.en: A complaint is a statement in which you express your dissatisfaction with a particular situation.

words.tr: n. 转发；转送；运输（尤指货物）
words.ex: He is forwarding the email to his boss.
words.ex_cn: 他正在把这封邮件转发给他的老板。
words.en: the act of sending something on to another destination or person

words.tr: adj. 有深刻了解的；富有洞察力的
words.ex: His insightful comment helped us understand the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他富有洞察力的评论帮助我们理解了这个问题。
words.en: If you describe someone or their remarks as insightful, you mean that they show a very good understanding of people and situations.

words.ex: The wavy line looks like a snake.
words.ex_cn: 波浪形的线看起来像一条蛇。
words.en: Something that is wavy has a series of curves or waves in it.

words.tr: adj. 遭到陷害的；（图画）放在框中的；（建筑物）以某种材料为其结构的; v. 制订；建造；给……...
words.ex: He was framed for stealing the money.
words.ex_cn: 他被陷害偷了钱。
words.en: If something is framed, it is surrounded or enclosed by a border or structure, or it is presented in a particular way.

words.ex: The volume of the box is 10 cubic meters.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子的体积是10立方米。
words.en: A volume is a book, especially one that is part of a series of books. It can also refer to the amount of space that a substance or object occupies, or the level of sound produced by a television, radio, etc.

words.ex: The riddler asks a hard question.
words.ex_cn: 谜语人问了一个难题。
words.en: A person who poses riddles or puzzles, often in a challenging or mysterious manner.

words.tr:
n. 山；
v. 逐渐增加；
words.ex: He climbed the mount early in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 他一大早爬了那座山。
words.en: To mount something means to go up it or to get on it. It can also refer to the act of organizing and beginning something, such as an event or an exhibition.

words.tr: n. 远足；徒步旅行； v. 增加；“hike”的现在分词；
words.ex: He loves hiking in the mountains on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在周末去山里远足。
words.en: Hiking is the activity of going for long walks in the countryside for pleasure.

words.ex: The children play near the foothills after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后在山脚下玩耍。
words.en: Foothills are low hills at the base of a mountain or mountain range.

words.ex: He is backpacking across Europe this summer.
words.ex_cn: 他今年夏天正在欧洲背包旅行。
words.en: Backpacking is the activity of traveling while carrying your belongings in a backpack, especially when you are walking long distances.

words.ex: They bought souvenirs from the gift shop.
words.ex_cn: 他们从礼品店买了纪念品。
words.en: Objects that you buy or keep to remind yourself of a special occasion or a place you have visited.

words.ex: Jenny is eating an apple.
words.ex_cn: 珍妮正在吃一个苹果。
words.en: A jenny is a female donkey or a spinning machine.

words.ex: The company rejects all applications that do not meet the criteria.
words.ex_cn: 公司拒绝所有不符合标准的申请。
words.en: To refuse to accept, consider, or use something or someone.

words.tr: v. 度蜜月（honeymoon的现在分词形式）
words.ex: They are honeymooning in Bali.
words.ex_cn: 他们正在巴厘岛度蜜月。
words.en: Spending a honeymoon, the holiday taken by a couple immediately after their wedding.

words.tr:
adj. 编号的；有限的；时日无多的
v. 总计；归入；算作；编号；“number”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: The pages are numbered.
words.ex_cn: 这些页面是有编号的。
words.en: Having a number or numbers assigned; limited in number.

words.ex: Water and oil are liquids.
words.ex_cn: 水和油是液体。
words.en: A liquid is a substance which is not solid but which flows and can be poured, for example water.

words.tr: n. 和平女神（希腊神话中和平女神的名字）
words.ex: Irene was worshipped as the goddess of peace in ancient Greece.
words.ex_cn: n. 在古希腊，伊蕾涅被尊为和平女神。
words.en: In Greek mythology, Irene is the goddess of peace, one of the Horae, the personifications of the seasons and the natural order.

words.tr: v. 请求；乞求；逃避；“beg”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: He begged for help when he was lost.
words.ex_cn: 当他迷路时，他恳求帮助。
words.en: Asked for something urgently and emotionally.

words.ex: The dove is a symbol of peace.
words.ex_cn: 鸽子是和平的象征。
words.en: Symbols are marks or signs that represent something else, such as an idea, a quality, or a relationship.

words.tr:
n. 录像带；
v. 给…录像；
words.ex: He found an old videotape in the drawer.
words.ex_cn: 他在抽屉里找到了一盘旧录像带。
words.en: Videotape is magnetic tape used for recording video images, typically along with sound.

words.tr: v. 洗劫；彻底搜查；翻箱倒柜地寻找
words.ex: He was ransacking his room for the missing keys.
words.ex_cn: 他正在房间里翻找丢失的钥匙。
words.en: Searching through a place thoroughly, often in a violent or destructive way, to find something.

words.tr: n. 非贵族出身的地主，小地主；乡绅
words.ex: Benjamin Franklin invented the lightning rod.
words.ex_cn: 本杰明·富兰克林发明了避雷针。
words.en: A name, particularly referring to Benjamin Franklin, a Founding Father of the United States, or a term used in medieval England to denote a freeholder who was not of noble birth.

words.ex: The teacher monitors the students' progress each week.
words.ex_cn: 老师每周监控学生的进步。
words.en: A monitor is a machine that is used to check or record things, for example in a factory or hospital. In a school, a monitor is a student who helps the teacher with various duties.

words.tr:
n. 第十一；
adj. 十一分之一的；
words.ex: He finished in the eleventh place.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了第十一名。
words.en: The ordinal number matching the number 11 in a series.

words.ex: He works in the math departments at the university.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学的数学系工作。
words.en: A department is one of the sections in an organization such as a government, business, or university. Departments are often responsible for a particular area of work or study.

words.ex: The nameplate on the door indicated it was the manager's office.
words.ex_cn: 门上的铭牌表明那是经理的办公室。
words.en: A nameplate is a sign or a plate on a door, wall, or machine which shows the name of the person or company associated with it.

words.ex: The basis of math is numbers.
words.ex_cn: 数学的基础是数字。
words.en: The underlying support or foundation for an idea, argument, or process.

words.ex: The snake is a natural shedder of its skin.
words.ex_cn: 蛇是自然的蜕皮者。
words.en: A shedder is something or someone that sheds, such as an animal that loses its fur or skin.

words.ex: He gets headaches after long hours of screen time.
words.ex_cn: 他长时间看屏幕后会头痛。
words.en: Headaches are pains in your head that can make you feel uncomfortable and can be caused by various factors such as stress, illness, or tension.

words.ex: He tries to synthesize ideas from different books.
words.ex_cn: 他试图综合来自不同书籍的想法。
words.en: To synthesize means to combine different ideas, influences, or objects into a new whole, or to produce a substance by a chemical reaction in plants or animals.

words.tr: n. 抗体（机体免疫系统产生的能识别并中和外来物质的蛋白质）
words.ex: His body made antibodies to fight the virus.
words.ex_cn: 他的身体产生了抗体来对抗病毒。
words.en: Proteins produced by the immune system to identify and neutralize pathogens.

words.ex: They will exhume the body next week.
words.ex_cn: 他们下周会挖出尸体。
words.en: To exhume a dead body means to dig it up, especially in order to examine it or to find out how the person died.

words.ex: He put pesto on his pasta.
words.ex_cn: 他在意大利面上加了青酱。
words.en: Pesto is a sauce originating in Genoa, Italy, traditionally made from crushed garlic, basil, and pine nuts blended with olive oil, Parmigiano-Reggiano cheese, and salt.

words.tr: n. 凯撒（古罗马的统治者）；帝王；独裁者；
words.ex: Caesar was a powerful leader in ancient Rome.
words.ex_cn: 凯撒是古罗马的一位强大统治者。
words.en: Caesar is a title used by Roman emperors, derived from the name of Julius Caesar, a Roman general and statesman.

words.tr: n. 无价值之物；苏（昔日法国的一种铜币），无价值之物( sou的名词复数 )；
words.ex: He threw the old sous into the trash.
words.ex_cn: 他把那些无价值的旧硬币扔进了垃圾桶。
words.en: A sous is a chef's assistant, often the second in command in a kitchen.

words.tr: n. 文件；公文；文献；“document”的复数；
words.ex: He filed all the documents in the drawer.
words.ex_cn: 他把所有文件都放在抽屉里了。
words.en: Documents are written, drawn, or printed materials that provide information or evidence.

words.tr: n. 小丑；爱开玩笑的人；家伙
words.ex: He's the class joker, always making everyone laugh.
words.ex_cn: 他是班上的开心果，总是逗大家笑。
words.en: A joker is someone who is always making jokes or trying to make people laugh. In card games, the joker is a special card that can sometimes be used as a wild card.

words.tr: v. 使厌恶；令人反感（第三人称单数形式）
words.ex: The smell disgusts him.
words.ex_cn: 这气味让他感到恶心。
words.en: Causes intense revulsion or strong dislike.

words.ex: The treasure lies neath the ancient oak.
words.ex_cn: 宝藏藏在古橡树下。
words.en: Beneath; under.

words.tr:
n. 钉；支柱
v. 钉（木桩等）以固定；限定
words.ex: He hung the hat on a peg.
words.ex_cn: 他把帽子挂在了一个钉子上。
words.en: A peg is a small device, usually made of wood or metal, that is used to fasten things or to hang things on.

words.tr:
n. 摩门教徒
adj. 摩门教的
words.ex: He is a Mormon and goes to church every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名摩门教徒，每周日都去教堂。
words.en: A member of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints, a religion founded in the United States by Joseph Smith in 1830.

words.ex: Don't be such a wally and listen to the instructions.
words.ex_cn: 别这么傻，好好听指示。
words.en: A silly or inept person; someone who is foolish or lacks common sense.

words.tr:
adj. 蛮勇的；鲁莽大胆的
n. 鲁莽大胆的人
words.ex: He is a daredevil rider who jumps over cars.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个蛮勇的骑手，会跳过汽车。
words.en: A daredevil is someone who enjoys doing dangerous things and taking risks.

words.tr: v. 欢呼；喝彩；使高兴；使振奋（cheer 的过去式和过去分词）
words.ex: The crowd cheered when the team scored.
words.ex_cn: 当球队得分时，观众欢呼起来。
words.en: Made someone feel happier or more hopeful.

words.tr:
v. 引用；报价；
n. 引用；引文；报价；
words.ex: He quoted Shakespeare in his speech.
words.ex_cn: 他在演讲中引用了莎士比亚的话。
words.en: To repeat or copy out (a group of words from a text or speech), typically with an indication that one is not the original author or speaker.

words.ex: His daily routine is mundane and boring.
words.ex_cn: 他的日常生活平凡而无聊。
words.en: Something that is mundane is very ordinary and not at all interesting or unusual.

words.tr: n. 新闻广播员；新闻播音员
words.ex: The newscaster reported the weather today.
words.ex_cn: 新闻主播今天报道了天气。
words.en: A newscaster is a person who reads the news on television or radio.

words.tr:
n. 怨恨；积怨；嫌隙
v. 勉强做；不情愿地给；吝惜
words.ex: He holds a grudge against his brother.
words.ex_cn: 他对他哥哥心怀怨恨。
words.en: A grudge is a persistent feeling of ill will or resentment resulting from a past insult or injury.

words.tr: n. 旋转；单脚尖旋转（尤指芭蕾舞中的）
words.ex: The dancer spins in pirouettes on stage.
words.ex_cn: 舞者在舞台上旋转着做单足转。
words.en: Performs a rapid spin or turn on one point, as in ballet.

words.ex: He was often teased for being a wimp.
words.ex_cn: 他经常因为懦弱而被嘲笑。
words.en: A wimp is someone who is not brave or confident.

words.tr:
adj. 红了脸的；兴奋的；激动的
v. 冲洗；脸红；冲（抽水马桶）；“flush”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: She felt her cheeks grow flushed with embarrassment.
words.ex_cn: 她感到自己的脸因尴尬而涨红。
words.en: If someone is flushed, their face is red because they are hot, excited, or embarrassed.

words.tr:
n. 僵局；和棋；僵持状态
v. 使陷入僵局
words.ex: The two players are in a stalemate.
words.ex_cn: 两位选手陷入了僵局。
words.en: A situation in which further action or progress by opposing parties seems impossible.

words.tr: adj. 达到极限的；用尽的（常用于短语 maxed out）
words.ex: He maxed his credit card last month.
words.ex_cn: 他上个月刷爆了信用卡。
words.en: Has reached the maximum limit or capacity.

words.ex: He said a prayer before bed.
words.ex_cn: 他睡前做了一次祈祷。
words.en: A prayer is a form of religious practice in which people communicate with a deity or spirit, often to ask for help or to give thanks.

words.ex: The army corps marched through the town.
words.ex_cn: 军队军团穿过城镇行进。
words.en: A corps is a military unit consisting of a large number of soldiers, typically organized for a specific purpose.

words.ex: The spies watched the building at night.
words.ex_cn: 间谍们在晚上监视着那栋大楼。
words.en: Observes or monitors secretly.

words.ex: He is learning elementary math at school.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校学习初级数学。
words.en: Elementary means relating to the simplest and most basic aspects of a subject.

words.tr: n. 乌拉圭（南美洲国家）
words.ex: He is from Uruguay.
words.ex_cn: 他来自乌拉圭。
words.en: Uruguay is a country in South America, located between Brazil and Argentina, known for its beaches and beef production.

words.ex: The small towns are quiet and peaceful.
words.ex_cn: 这些小镇安静而平和。
words.en: A town is a place with many streets and buildings, where people live and work. It is larger than a village but smaller than a city.

words.tr: n. 复出；重返；再度受欢迎；
words.ex: His comeback after injury surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他伤愈复出令所有人惊讶。
words.en: A comeback is a return by a well-known person, especially an entertainer or sports player, to the activity in which they have formerly been successful.

words.ex: The solar panel collects energy from the sun.
words.ex_cn: 太阳能板从太阳收集能量。
words.en: Solar means relating to the sun or using the energy from the sun to produce electricity.

words.tr: n. [天]行星；星球；星球（planet 的复数形式）；
words.ex: The planets move around the sun.
words.ex_cn: 行星围绕太阳运行。
words.en: A planet is a celestial body moving in an elliptical orbit around a star.

words.ex: He slapped the table in anger.
words.ex_cn: 他生气地拍了桌子。
words.en: Struck someone or something with the palm of the hand, often in a forceful or sudden manner.

words.tr: adj. 凭冲动行事的；易冲动的
words.ex: He made an impulsive decision to quit his job.
words.ex_cn: 他一时冲动决定辞掉工作。
words.en: If you describe someone as impulsive, you mean that they do things suddenly without thinking about them carefully first.

words.tr:
n. 战斗；
v. 战斗；
words.ex: The soldiers fought in a long battle.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们进行了一场漫长的战斗。
words.en: A battle is a violent fight between groups of people, especially one between military forces during a war.

words.tr:
n. 暴躁脾气；情绪；心情；性情
v. 使…缓和；冲淡
words.ex: He loses his temper when he is tired.
words.ex_cn: 当他累了的时候，他会发脾气。
words.en: If you refer to someone's temper or say that they have a temper, you mean that they become angry very easily.

words.ex: He uses this park exclusively for walking.
words.ex_cn: 他只在这个公园散步。
words.en: If you do something exclusively, you do it only in the way mentioned, and not in any other way.

words.ex: He used a chainsaw to cut down the tree.
words.ex_cn: 他用链锯把树砍倒了。
words.en: A chainsaw is a portable mechanical saw, powered by electricity, compressed air, hydraulic power, or most commonly a two-stroke engine. It is used in activities such as tree felling, limbing, bucking, pruning, cutting firebreaks in wildland fire suppression, and harvesting of firewood.

words.tr: n. 困惑；不安；心神不安
words.ex: He felt disconcertment when the plan failed.
words.ex_cn: 当计划失败时，他感到不安。
words.en: A feeling of unease, embarrassment, or confusion.

words.tr: adj. 详细的；细致的； v. “detail”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He gave a detailed description of the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他对事故做了详细的描述。
words.en: A detailed account or report contains a lot of details.

words.ex: He is interested in politics.
words.ex_cn: 他对政治感兴趣。
words.en: Politics are the actions or activities concerned with achieving and using power in a country or society. The verb that follows politics may be either singular or plural.

words.ex: He is an equestrian rider who trains every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位每天早上训练的骑马者。
words.en: An equestrian is someone who rides horses, especially as a sport or a profession.

words.ex: The cowgirl rode her horse across the prairie.
words.ex_cn: 女牛仔骑着她的马穿过草原。
words.en: A cowgirl is a woman who works with cattle, especially in the western United States, and who typically rides a horse.

words.ex: The ballerina dances gracefully on stage.
words.ex_cn: 芭蕾舞女演员在舞台上优雅地跳舞。
words.en: A ballerina is a female ballet dancer.

words.tr: adj. 母亲的；母性的；母系的；
words.ex: Her maternal love kept the family strong.
words.ex_cn: 她的母爱让家庭保持坚强。
words.en: Maternal feelings or actions are typical of a kind, loving mother.

words.ex: He earns money by washing cars.
words.ex_cn: 他通过洗车赚钱。
words.en: To earn means to receive money as payment for work that you do, or to get something that you deserve because of your qualities or actions.

words.ex: He proved the theorem in math class.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学课上证明了这个定理。
words.en: A theorem is a statement that has been proven on the basis of previously established statements, such as other theorems, and generally accepted statements, such as axioms.

words.tr:
n. 市中心区；商业区；
adv. 在市区；往市区；
words.ex: We went downtown to buy some clothes.
words.ex_cn: 我们去市中心买了一些衣服。
words.en: Downtown refers to the central part or main business and commercial area of a city or town.

words.tr: v. 摇摆行走；蹒跚而行
words.ex: The duck waddles across the pond.
words.ex_cn: 鸭子摇摆着走过池塘。
words.en: Walks with short, clumsy steps, swaying from side to side.

words.ex: The launch of Sputnik in 1957 marked the beginning of the space age.
words.ex_cn: 1957年Sputnik的发射标志着太空时代的开始。
words.en: The first artificial Earth satellite, which was launched by the Soviet Union in 1957.

words.tr: n. 小锄，剥树皮的铲凿，马铃薯 vt. 用小锄锄
words.ex: He used a spud to dig up the potatoes.
words.ex_cn: 他用小锄挖出了马铃薯。
words.en: A potato, especially one used for cooking.

words.ex: She poured the pasta through a colander.
words.ex_cn: 她把意大利面倒进漏勺里。
words.en: A colander is a bowl-shaped kitchen utensil with holes in it used for draining food such as pasta or washing vegetables.

words.ex: The ant moved its antennae to feel the ground.
words.ex_cn: 蚂蚁用触角感知地面。
words.en: Antennae are the long, thin sensory appendages on the heads of insects, crustaceans, and some other arthropods, used for touch and smell. In technology, an antenna is a device used to transmit or receive radio waves.

words.ex: The ant moved its antenna to feel the ground.
words.ex_cn: 蚂蚁用它的触角感知地面。
words.en: An antenna is a device that sends and receives radio or television signals. In biology, it refers to the long, thin sensory appendages on the heads of insects and crustaceans.

words.ex: He prays every morning before breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃早餐前祈祷。
words.en: To pray means to speak to God in order to give thanks or to ask for something.

words.ex: He changed his stance on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他改变了对气候变化的立场。
words.en: A stance is a particular way of standing, especially in sports such as golf or baseball, or a person's attitude or opinion about something, especially when it is stated publicly.

words.ex: He is toasting bread for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他正在为早餐烤面包。
words.en: Toasting refers to the act of browning bread or other food by exposure to heat, or the act of drinking to someone's health or in honor of someone or something.

words.ex: The children are playing on the rugs in the living room.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在客厅的地毯上玩耍。
words.en: A rug is a piece of thick material that you put on the floor to cover it or to make it more comfortable to stand or sit on.

words.tr: v. 唇嘟起；发脾气；（尤指因不满而）撅嘴
words.ex: He pouts when he doesn't get candy.
words.ex_cn: 当他得不到糖果时，他会撅嘴。
words.en: Displays displeasure by pushing out the lower lip.

words.tr: v. （在科学研究中）观测；发现；注视；监视；（在科学研究中）观测，发现（observe 的现在分词）；
words.ex: Scientists are observing the stars with a telescope.
words.ex_cn: 科学家们正在用望远镜观测恒星。
words.en: to watch carefully the way something happens or the way someone does something, especially in order to learn more about it

words.ex: Brenda is my best friend.
words.ex_cn: 布伦达是我最好的朋友。
words.en: Brenda is a female given name of Old Norse origin, meaning 'sword' or 'torch'.

words.tr:
n. 缺乏；短缺；
v. 缺乏；短缺；
words.ex: There is a lack of clean water in the village.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄缺乏干净的水。
words.en: If there is a lack of something, there is not enough of it or it does not exist at all.

words.ex: He wants to inquire about the bus schedule.
words.ex_cn: 他想询问公交车的时刻表。
words.en: If you inquire about something, you ask for information about it.

words.tr:
adj. 年长的；
n. 长者；
words.ex: My elder brother works as a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 我年长的哥哥是一名老师。
words.en: An elder is a person who is older than you, especially one who is respected for their wisdom and experience.

words.tr: v. 弄糟；失误；（尤指演员）忘词；n. 失误；绒毛
words.ex: He fluffs his lines during the play.
words.ex_cn: 他在演出时说错了台词。
words.en: Flutters or moves in a light, irregular manner.

words.ex: The jury decided the man was innocent.
words.ex_cn: 陪审团裁定这个人无罪。
words.en: A jury is a group of people who are chosen to decide whether someone is guilty or not guilty of a crime in a court of law.

words.ex: He had to relinquish his seat to an old man.
words.ex_cn: 他不得不把座位让给一位老人。
words.en: If you relinquish something, such as power or control, you give it up, often unwillingly.

words.ex: He spoke quietly lest he wake the baby.
words.ex_cn: 他低声说话，以免吵醒婴儿。
words.en: If you do something lest something unpleasant should happen, you do it to try to prevent the unpleasant thing from happening.

words.tr: v. 飞；坐飞机；“fly”的过去分词；
words.ex: The bird has flown away.
words.ex_cn: 这只鸟已经飞走了。
words.en: Flown is the past participle of fly, meaning to move through the air using wings.

words.ex: He spoke distinctly so everyone could understand.
words.ex_cn: 他说话很清晰，以便每个人都能听懂。
words.en: In a way that is clear and unmistakable.

words.ex: The children feed donkeys at the farm.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在农场喂驴。
words.en: Donkeys are domesticated animals used primarily as working animals for transporting goods or people.

words.ex: The donkey carries water on the hill.
words.ex_cn: 这头驴在山上驮水。
words.en: A donkey is a four-legged animal related to the horse, but smaller and with longer ears. Donkeys are often used for carrying or pulling things, especially in parts of the world where there are no cars or trucks.

words.ex: The tide comes in every twelve hours.
words.ex_cn: 潮汐每十二小时涨一次。
words.en: The tide is the regular change in the level of the sea on the shore.

words.ex: The children are playing in the pools.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们正在泳池里玩耍。
words.en: A pool is a small area of still water, especially one that has formed naturally. It can also refer to a swimming pool. As a verb, to pool means to combine resources or efforts for a common purpose.

words.ex: He looked at me with confusion.
words.ex_cn: 他困惑地看着我。
words.en: A state of uncertainty about what is happening, intended, or required.

words.ex: He apologizes for being late.
words.ex_cn: 他为迟到道歉。
words.en: Expresses regret or remorse for a wrongdoing or mistake.

words.ex: The first talkies revolutionized the film industry.
words.ex_cn: 第一批有声电影彻底改变了电影产业。
words.en: Talkies refer to films with synchronized sound, as opposed to silent films.

words.ex: The screens show clear images.
words.ex_cn: 这些屏幕显示清晰的图像。
words.en: Screens are flat surfaces on which pictures or data are displayed. They can also refer to the act of showing a film or movie, or to the process of examining people or things in order to decide if they are suitable for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The mobile table can be moved easily.
words.ex_cn: 这个可移动的桌子很容易搬动。
words.en: A mobile is something that can move or be moved easily.

words.tr: v. 开花；“flower”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The garden flowered in spring.
words.ex_cn: 花园在春天开了花。
words.en: Having flowers; decorated with flowers.

words.tr: adj. 烦人的； v. “nag”的现在分词；
words.ex: The nagging sound of the alarm woke me up.
words.ex_cn: 烦人的闹钟声把我吵醒了。
words.en: If you describe someone as nagging, you mean that they keep asking or telling you to do something, in an annoying way.

words.ex: Sugar is an ingredient in this cake.
words.ex_cn: 糖是这个蛋糕的一个成分。
words.en: An ingredient is one of the substances that are combined to make something, especially in cooking.

words.tr: adj. 花边的；有花边装饰的
words.ex: She wore a lacey dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一件有花边装饰的裙子去参加派对。
words.en: Lacey is an adjective used to describe something that is made of or decorated with lace, a delicate fabric with an open web-like pattern.

words.ex: The translation of the book took two months.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的翻译花了两个月。
words.en: The process of translating words or text from one language into another.

words.tr: adj. 摇晃的；颤抖的；不稳固的
words.ex: His hands are shaky when he holds the cup.
words.ex_cn: 他拿杯子时手在发抖。
words.en: If you describe a situation as shaky, you mean that it is weak or unstable, and seems unlikely to last long or be successful.

words.ex: The storm disrupted the train service.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴中断了火车服务。
words.en: To disrupt a system, process, or event means to prevent it from continuing or operating in a normal way.

words.ex: The dog poop is on the grass.
words.ex_cn: 狗屎在草地上。
words.en: Poop refers to the solid waste that is released from the body through the anus.

words.tr: n. 佛兰芒人（比利时北部说荷兰语的民族）
words.ex: The Fleming is known for their rich cultural heritage.
words.ex_cn: 佛兰芒人以他们丰富的文化遗产而闻名。
words.en: A Fleming is a person from Flanders, the Dutch-speaking northern part of Belgium, known for their distinct cultural and linguistic identity.

words.tr: v. 叙述；给（电视或电影）作旁白
words.ex: He will narrate the story to his little sister.
words.ex_cn: 他将为他的小妹妹讲述这个故事。
words.en: If you narrate a story, you tell it from your own point of view.

words.ex: She makes a quilt for her baby.
words.ex_cn: 她为宝宝做了一床被子。
words.en: A quilt is a bed cover made by sewing layers of fabric together, often with a layer of padding in between, to provide warmth.

words.tr: n. 制造噪音的人或物；喧闹装置
words.ex: The child shook the noisemaker at the parade.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在游行中摇动了噪音制造器。
words.en: An object or device that produces a loud noise, often for celebration.

words.ex: His openness helped the team trust him.
words.ex_cn: 他的开放态度让团队信任他。
words.en: The quality or state of being open, especially in terms of being honest and not hiding one's thoughts or feelings.

words.ex: His mistakes had serious consequences.
words.ex_cn: 他的错误带来了严重的后果。
words.en: The results or effects of actions or conditions.

words.tr:
adj. 摩洛哥的
n. 摩洛哥人
words.ex: The Moroccan market is full of vibrant colors and exotic spices.
words.ex_cn: 摩洛哥市场充满了鲜艳的色彩和异国情调的香料。
words.en: Moroccan refers to something or someone that is from Morocco, a country in North Africa, or relates to its culture, people, or language.

words.ex: You can pay conveniently online.
words.ex_cn: 你可以方便地在线支付。
words.en: In a way that is suitable for one's needs or purposes; in a way that is easy to use or access.

words.tr:
v. 撒尿
n. 小便
words.ex: He went outside to take a piss.
words.ex_cn: 他出去小便。
words.en: To urinate; to pass liquid waste from the body.

words.ex: He uses a lot of slang when talking with friends.
words.ex_cn: 他和朋友聊天时用很多俚语。
words.en: Slang refers to a type of language that consists of words and phrases that are regarded as very informal, are more common in speech than writing, and are typically restricted to a particular context or group of people.

words.ex: The little girl drew a unicorn in her notebook.
words.ex_cn: 小女孩在笔记本上画了一只独角兽。
words.en: A unicorn is a mythical creature typically represented as a horse with a single straight horn projecting from its forehead.

words.ex: Helping the poor is a mitzvah in Judaism.
words.ex_cn: 帮助穷人是犹太教中的一条诫命或善行。
words.en: In Judaism, a mitzvah is a commandment or a good deed.

words.tr: n. （爱尔兰民间传说中的）小妖精
words.ex: The leprechaun is often depicted as a small, bearded man wearing a green suit.
words.ex_cn: 小妖精常被描绘成一个穿着绿色西装的小胡子男人。
words.en: A leprechaun is a type of fairy in Irish folklore, usually depicted as a little old man who is a cobbler and has a hidden pot of gold.

words.ex: The baby had a baptism in the church.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿在教堂接受了洗礼。
words.en: Baptism is a Christian sacrament of initiation and adoption, almost invariably with the use of water.

words.tr: n. 未婚女子；单身女子
words.ex: The bachelorette went out with her friends for a night.
words.ex_cn: 单身女性和朋友们出去过了一晚。
words.en: A bachelorette is a young unmarried woman, especially one who is considered to be attractive and is enjoying her single life.

words.ex: He preaches kindness every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周日都宣扬仁爱。
words.en: If you preach, you give a talk on a religious or moral subject during a religious service.

words.ex: She untied the knot in the rope.
words.ex_cn: 她解开了绳子上的结。
words.en: If you untie something that is tied or if it unties, you undo the knot or the fastening that holds it.

words.tr:
adj. 不愿分享的；占有欲强的；所有格的
n. 所有格
words.ex: The cat is possessive of its toy.
words.ex_cn: 这只猫对它的玩具很占有。
words.en: If you are possessive about something that you own, you do not like lending it to other people or sharing it with other people.

words.ex: My grandchild loves to play with me.
words.ex_cn: 我的孙子/孙女喜欢和我一起玩。
words.en: A grandchild is the child of your son or daughter.

words.tr: adj. 被损坏的； v. 损害；“damage”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The damaged car could not start.
words.ex_cn: 这辆受损的车无法启动。
words.en: If something is damaged, it is harmed or spoiled.

words.ex: The irate customer shouted at the clerk.
words.ex_cn: 这位愤怒的顾客对店员大喊大叫。
words.en: If someone is irate, they are very angry about something.

words.tr:
adj. 第十八的；
n. 第十八；
words.ex: He was born on the eighteenth day of May.
words.ex_cn: 他出生于五月十八日。
words.en: The eighteenth item in a series is the one that you count as number eighteen.

words.ex: He moved to Calcutta last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年搬到了加尔各答。
words.en: A city in eastern India, formerly the capital of British India.

words.tr: n. 人工制品；手工艺品；加工品
words.ex: The museum has an ancient artifact.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆里有一件古代文物。
words.en: An artifact is an object that is made by a person, especially something of historical or cultural interest.

words.ex: No example sentences
words.ex_cn: 没有例句
words.en: Prostitute (informal, often derogatory).

words.ex: Pitt is a common surname in English-speaking countries.
words.ex_cn: 皮特是英语国家中常见的姓氏。
words.en: Pitt is a surname of English origin, commonly used as a last name in English-speaking countries.

words.ex: He was born in Detroit.
words.ex_cn: 他出生在底特律。
words.en: A major city in the state of Michigan, USA, known historically as the center of the American automotive industry.

words.tr: n. [动] 雌雄同体；阴阳人；两性体；[植] 雌雄同株; adj. [动] 雌雄同体的
words.ex: The hermaphrodite plant can self-pollinate.
words.ex_cn: 这种雌雄同体的植物可以自花授粉。
words.en: A hermaphrodite is an organism that has both male and female reproductive organs.

words.ex: He has a big ego and likes to show off.
words.ex_cn: 他自尊心很强，喜欢炫耀。
words.en: Your ego is your opinion of your own worth. For example, if someone has a big ego, they think they are very important and valuable.

words.ex: A sliver of wood stuck in his finger.
words.ex_cn: 一小片木头扎进了他的手指。
words.en: A sliver is a small, thin piece of something that has been cut, broken, or torn off from a larger piece.

words.ex: Great thinkers often challenge the status quo.
words.ex_cn: 伟大的思想家常常挑战现状。
words.en: Thinkers are people who spend a lot of time thinking deeply about important things, especially those who are known for their original ideas.

words.ex: The leaders of the team made a good decision.
words.ex_cn: 团队的领袖做出了一个正确的决定。
words.en: Leaders are people who guide or direct others, often in a political, business, or organizational context. They are responsible for making decisions, setting goals, and motivating others to achieve those goals.

words.ex: He buys poultry at the local market.
words.ex_cn: 他在当地市场买家禽。
words.en: Poultry refers to domesticated birds kept by humans for their eggs, meat, or feathers.

words.ex: The old man walks with a cane.
words.ex_cn: 这位老人拄着藤杖走路。
words.en: A cane is a long, thin stick that you can use to help you walk, or it is a stick used for punishing people by hitting them. It is also a tall, hard plant like bamboo, from which sugar is made.

words.ex: She is a good student.
words.ex_cn: 她是一个好学生。
words.en: Something that is good is of a high quality, standard, or level.

words.tr: n. 凹陷；弯曲变形；（非正式）闲聊，八卦（dish 的动名词或现在分词形式）
words.ex: He is dishing out food at the cafeteria.
words.ex_cn: 他正在食堂分发食物。
words.en: A colloquial verb meaning to reveal or disclose confidential or private information, often in a gossipy or sensational manner.

words.ex: He ref used the reference book to find the answer.
words.ex_cn: 他用参考书找到了答案。
words.en: 1. In sports, a referee is an official who watches a game or match closely to ensure that the rules are adhered to and to arbitrate on matters arising from the play. 2. In academic or professional writing, a ref is a short form for reference, which is a mention of a source of information.

words.ex: He was born in August.
words.ex_cn: 他出生在八月。
words.en: August is the eighth month of the Gregorian calendar, following July and preceding September.

words.ex: The lions sleep under the tree.
words.ex_cn: 狮子在树下睡觉。
words.en: Lions are large, powerful carnivores of the family Felidae, often referred to as the 'king of the jungle'.

words.tr:
n. 入店行窃；顺手牵羊
v. 从商店里偷东西；“shoplift”的现在分词
words.ex: He was arrested for shoplifting.
words.ex_cn: 他因商店行窃被捕。
words.en: The act of stealing goods from a shop while pretending to be a customer.

words.ex: He buys melons at the market every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他每星期天在市场买西瓜。
words.en: Large, sweet fruits with a hard rind and juicy flesh, typically grown on vines in warm climates.

words.ex: He ate a wienie at the picnic.
words.ex_cn: 他在野餐时吃了一根热狗。
words.en: A small sausage; a weak or ineffectual person.

words.ex: This region has many mountains.
words.ex_cn: 这个地区有很多山。
words.en: A region is a large area of land that is different from other areas of land, for example because it is one of the different parts of a country with its own customs and characteristics, or because it has a particular geographical feature.

words.tr: n. 马车夫; n. （Carter）（美）卡特（人名）
words.ex: The carter carefully guided his horses through the narrow streets.
words.ex_cn: 马车夫小心翼翼地引导他的马穿过狭窄的街道。
words.en: A carter is a person who drives a cart, especially one who transports goods.

words.tr: n. 讲虚构故事的人；传奇小说作家
words.ex: The romancer spun tales of adventure and romance.
words.ex_cn: 这位传奇小说作家讲述了冒险和浪漫的故事。
words.en: A romancer is someone who writes or tells stories that are full of adventure, love, and excitement, often set in the past or in imaginary worlds.

words.tr:
v. 使混乱；使杂乱
n. 杂乱；混乱
words.ex: He jumbled the letters and could not read the word.
words.ex_cn: 他把字母弄乱了，无法认出这个单词。
words.en: To mix things together in a confused or untidy way.

words.ex: Anita is playing the piano.
words.ex_cn: 阿尼塔在弹钢琴。
words.en: Anita is a female given name, derived from the Spanish name Ana, which is a form of the Hebrew name Hannah, meaning 'grace' or 'favor'.

words.ex: The reproductive system helps animals have babies.
words.ex_cn: 生殖系统帮助动物生育后代。
words.en: Relating to or effecting reproduction in living organisms.

words.ex: The knight held a long lance in his hand.
words.ex_cn: 骑士手中握着一支长矛。
words.en: A lance is a long weapon used in the past by soldiers on horseback, consisting of a wooden shaft with a pointed metal end. As a verb, to lance means to pierce or cut open with a sharp instrument, especially a lance.

words.ex: The ground is damp after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 雨后地面是潮湿的。
words.en: Something that is damp is slightly wet, often in a way that is unpleasant.

words.tr:
n. 照片；相片；
v. 拍照；
words.ex: He showed me a photograph of his dog.
words.ex_cn: 他给我看了他狗的照片。
words.en: A photograph is a picture that is made using a camera.

words.ex: He traveled to Thailand last summer.
words.ex_cn: 他去年夏天去了泰国。
words.en: A country in Southeast Asia, known for its beaches, opulent royal palaces, ancient ruins and ornate temples displaying figures of Buddha.

words.tr: v. 创办；建立；“found”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He founded a school for poor children.
words.ex_cn: 他创办了一所为贫困儿童设立的学校。
words.en: If someone founds something such as a company, an organization, or an institution, they start it or create it.

words.ex: The void on the page made the text look empty.
words.ex_cn: 页面上的空白让文字看起来空荡荡的。
words.en: If you describe a situation or a feeling as a void, you mean that it seems empty because there is nothing interesting or worthwhile about it.

words.tr: n. 有价值的物品；商品( commodity的名词复数 )；
words.ex: Farmers sell commodities like wheat and corn.
words.ex_cn: 农民出售小麦和玉米等有价值的物品。
words.en: Commodities, raw materials or primary agricultural products that can be bought and sold, such as metals or crops.

words.ex: He brokered a deal between the two companies.
words.ex_cn: 他为两家公司安排了协商并达成协议。
words.en: A broker is a person whose job is to buy and sell shares, foreign money, or goods for other people.

words.tr: n. 仇敌；敌军；危害物；大敌；仇敌( enemy的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The two brothers became enemies after the fight.
words.ex_cn: 兄弟俩在打架后成了仇敌。
words.en: A person who is actively opposed or hostile to someone or something.

words.ex: He eats bread and rice for carbohydrates.
words.ex_cn: 他吃面包和米饭来获取碳水化合物。
words.en: Carbohydrates are substances, found in certain kinds of food, that provide your body with heat and energy and are made up of carbon, hydrogen, and oxygen.

words.tr: n. 傻瓜； Dummy 的复数形式，指无思想的人或用于演示的假人
words.ex: The book is for dummies who want to learn easy math.
words.ex_cn: 这本书是为想学简单数学的初学者准备的。
words.en: Objects shaped like human figures, used for practice or display.

words.ex: He uses a hair styler every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都用卷发棒。
words.en: A person or device that styles or arranges things, especially in fashion or hairdressing.

words.tr: n. 球场中央部分 adj. 中场的
words.ex: He plays midfield in the soccer team.
words.ex_cn: 他在足球队里踢中场。
words.en: The central area of a sports field, especially in football, between the defenders and forwards.

words.tr:
adj. 麻木的；失去知觉的
v. 使麻木；使迟钝
words.ex: His fingers felt numb after being in the cold.
words.ex_cn: 他的手指在寒冷中变得麻木。
words.en: If a part of your body is numb, you cannot feel it, usually for a short time.

words.tr:
n. 说唱乐
v. 说唱；敲击
words.ex: He loves to rap about his life in the city.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢说唱自己在城市里的生活。
words.en: A type of music characterized by rhythmic and/or rhyming speech that is chanted or rapped.

words.ex: The gangster stole money from the bank.
words.ex_cn: 这个黑帮分子偷了银行的钱。
words.en: A gangster is a member of a group of violent criminals.

words.ex: The cloud floats high in the sky.
words.ex_cn: 云朵在天空中飘浮。
words.en: A cloud is a visible mass of condensed water vapor floating in the atmosphere, typically high above the ground.

words.tr: adv. 古怪地；怪异地；反常地；
words.ex: He dressed oddly for the party.
words.ex_cn: 他穿着古怪地去参加派对。
words.en: In a manner that is strange or unusual.

words.tr: n. 马鞍袋；鞍袋（通常指挂在马鞍两侧的袋子）
words.ex: He tied the books to his saddlebags.
words.ex_cn: 他把书绑在马鞍袋上。
words.en: Pouches attached to a saddle for carrying items.

words.tr:
n. 包；捆
v. 捆成大包
words.ex: He tied the hay into a bale.
words.ex_cn: 他把干草捆成一捆。
words.en: A bale is a large quantity of something such as hay, paper, wool, or cloth that has been tied tightly into a rectangular shape.

words.ex: He is a superstar in basketball.
words.ex_cn: 他是篮球界的超级巨星。
words.en: A superstar is a person who is extremely famous and successful, especially in the entertainment industry.

words.ex: Hey, bub, can you pass me that ball?
words.ex_cn: 嘿，小家伙，你能把那个球递给我吗？
words.en: A term of endearment for a small child or young person.

words.tr:
adj. 年幼的；
n. 最小的儿子；
words.ex: He is the youngest in his family.
words.ex_cn: 他是家里最小的。
words.en: The youngest person in a group is the one who was born last and is therefore the least old.

words.ex: The plumber opened the manhole to access the sewer system.
words.ex_cn: 水管工打开了人孔以进入下水道系统。
words.en: A manhole is a covered opening in a road or pavement that provides access to a sewer or other underground utility.

words.tr: n. 恭维（compliment 的复数）；问候；道贺; v. 祝贺（compliment 的三单形...
words.ex: He gave her many compliments on her dress.
words.ex_cn: 他称赞了她的裙子很多次。
words.en: A compliment is a polite expression of praise or admiration.

words.ex: The shoes are scuffed from walking all day.
words.ex_cn: 这双鞋因为走了一整天而磨花了。
words.en: Adjective. Damaged or marked by scraping or wearing.

words.tr: n. 内部；内脏；内容；内幕
words.ex: The cat ate the insides of the mouse.
words.ex_cn: 猫吃掉了老鼠的内脏。
words.en: The internal organs of the body, especially the stomach and intestines.

words.ex: She wears long skirts in the summer.
words.ex_cn: 她夏天穿长裙子。
words.en: A skirt is a piece of clothing that fastens at the waist and hangs down around the legs. It can also refer to the edge or border of something, or to go around the edge of something.

words.tr: n. 注意力不集中的人；轻率浮躁的人
words.ex: She's a scatterbrain, always forgetting where she put her keys.
words.ex_cn: 她是个注意力不集中的人，总是忘记把钥匙放在哪里了。
words.en: A scatterbrain is a person who is often disorganized and forgetful.

words.ex: The dark passageway led to the basement.
words.ex_cn: 这条黑暗的通道通向地下室。
words.en: A passageway is a long narrow space with walls or fences on both sides, which connects one place or room with another.

words.tr:
v. 叮；“sting”的第三人称单数
n. 蜇伤；“sting”的复数
words.ex: The bee stings hurt a lot.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂的刺很疼。
words.en: If a plant, animal, or insect stings you, it pricks your skin and puts poison into your body, causing you pain.

words.tr: n. 避孕药具；避孕方法
words.ex: She uses contraceptives to avoid pregnancy.
words.ex_cn: 她使用避孕药来避免怀孕。
words.en: Devices or substances used to prevent pregnancy.

words.ex: He uses aluminum foil to wrap the food.
words.ex_cn: 他用铝箔纸包食物。
words.en: A light, silvery metal that is used especially for making cooking equipment and aircraft parts.

words.ex: The kidnappers took the boy and asked for money.
words.ex_cn: 绑匪绑架了那个男孩并索要赎金。
words.en: People who abduct someone and hold them for ransom.

words.ex: The loud noise was triggering her anxiety.
words.ex_cn: v. 巨大的噪音引发了她的焦虑。
words.en: To cause something to start or happen, especially a series of events.

words.ex: Mum made me a sandwich for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 妈妈给我做了一个三明治当午餐。
words.en: A mother; silent or not speaking.

words.ex: The locksmith was able to pick the lock in just a few minutes.
words.ex_cn: 锁匠在几分钟内就能把锁打开。
words.en: A locksmith is a person whose job is making and repairing locks.

words.tr: n. 半决赛（final 的复数形式）
words.ex: The team reached the semifinals last week.
words.ex_cn: 这支队伍上周进入了半决赛。
words.en: The round of a competition immediately before the final.

words.ex: The seagull flew over the beach.
words.ex_cn: 海鸥飞过了海滩。
words.en: A seagull is a common coastal bird that is known for its loud call and its habit of scavenging for food.

words.tr: v. 咀嚼（chew 的过去式和过去分词）
words.ex: He chewed his pencil while thinking.
words.ex_cn: 他思考时咬着铅笔。
words.en: Past tense and past participle of chew.

words.ex: He reported the harassment to the police.
words.ex_cn: 他向警察报告了骚扰行为。
words.en: Harassment is behaviour which is intended to trouble or annoy someone, especially repeated behaviour.

words.ex: He is experiencing heavy rain today.
words.ex_cn: 他今天正在经历大雨。
words.en: If you experience a particular situation, you are in that situation or it happens to you.

words.ex: The hard chair caused him discomfort.
words.ex_cn: 这把硬椅子让他感到不舒适。
words.en: Discomfort is a feeling of slight pain or physical unease, or a feeling of worry or embarrassment.

words.tr: adv. 不舒服地；不自在地
words.ex: He sat uncomfortably in the hard chair.
words.ex_cn: 他不舒服地坐在硬椅子上。
words.en: In a manner that causes discomfort or unease.

words.ex: The children behaved well during the trip.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在旅行中表现良好。
words.en: To act or conduct oneself in a specified way, especially towards others.

words.tr: n. 剪下的图样；挖剪图；断流器
words.ex: He made a paper cutout of a bird.
words.ex_cn: 他做了一个纸制的鸟形剪贴画。
words.en: A cutout is a shape or design that has been cut from a piece of paper, wood, or other material, or a device that stops the flow of electricity in a circuit.

words.ex: The weather is colder today.
words.ex_cn: 今天天气更冷了。
words.en: Comparative form of cold; having a lower temperature.

words.ex: He touched the pinkie of his left hand.
words.ex_cn: 他碰了左手的小指。
words.en: The smallest finger on the hand.

words.ex: Fitch gave the company a BBB rating.
words.ex_cn: 惠誉给这家公司评了BBB级。
words.en: A fitch is a small, carnivorous mammal known for its sleek fur, often used in the fur trade.

words.ex: They have conversations every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天晚上都有对话。
words.en: Conversations are informal talks between two or more people in which news and ideas are exchanged.

words.tr:
prep. 关于；鉴于
v. 尊重；尊敬；遵从；“respect”的现在分词
words.ex: We should be respecting others' opinions.
words.ex_cn: 我们应该尊重他人的意见。
words.en: prep. concerning; about

words.tr: n. 滑冰者（ skater的名词复数 ）
words.ex: The skaters glide smoothly on the ice.
words.ex_cn: 滑冰者在冰面上平稳地滑行。
words.en: Plural of skater; a person who skates, especially on ice or roller skates.

words.ex: He would cuss at the computer when it didn't work.
words.ex_cn: v. 当电脑不工作时，他会对它咒骂。
words.en: To use offensive or vulgar language; to swear.

words.ex: His neck was stiff after sleeping wrong.
words.ex_cn: 他睡姿不对，脖子变得僵硬。
words.en: If something is stiff, it is firm and does not bend easily. It can also describe a person who is not relaxed or friendly.

words.tr: n. 操纵杆；（游戏机的）游戏棒
words.ex: The boy moves the character with a joystick.
words.ex_cn: 男孩用操纵杆控制角色移动。
words.en: A joystick is an input device consisting of a stick that pivots on a base and reports its angle or direction to the device it is controlling.

words.tr: adj. 呈弯曲状的；弧形的； v. （使）弯成弧形；“curve”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The road is curved around the hill.
words.ex_cn: 这条路沿着山呈弯曲状。
words.en: Having the shape of a curve; not straight.

words.tr: v. 位于；使坐落于；查找…的地点；确定…的位置；“locate”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 坐落在；位于；
words.ex: The school is located near the park.
words.ex_cn: 学校位于公园附近。
words.en: If something is located in a particular place, it is in that place.

words.ex: Mabel walks to school every morning.
words.ex_cn: 梅布尔每天早上步行去学校。
words.en: A female given name, typically of English origin, meaning 'lovable' or 'dear'.

words.ex: He bought a soda from the vending machine.
words.ex_cn: 他从自动售货机买了一瓶苏打水。
words.en: The act of selling goods, especially through a vending machine.

words.tr: n. 狂欢；纵欲；无节制的行为
words.ex: He read about ancient orgies in a history book.
words.ex_cn: 他在一本历史书中读到了古代的狂欢派对。
words.en: Orgies refer to wild and excessive indulgence in sensual pleasures, often involving large groups of people.

words.ex: He will rename the file tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会重命名这个文件。
words.en: To give a new name to someone or something.

words.tr: v. 拔掉（插头）；断开连接（plugs 的第三人称单数形式）
words.ex: He unplugs the charger after the phone is full.
words.ex_cn: 手机充满后，他拔掉充电器。
words.en: Disconnects from an electrical power source.

words.ex: The tribe lives in a primitive hut.
words.ex_cn: 这个部落住在原始的小屋里。
words.en: Belonging to a very early period in the history of the world, or to a time before modern things existed.

words.ex: She gave birth to her baby after hours of childbirth.
words.ex_cn: 经过数小时的分娩，她生下了孩子。
words.en: The process of giving birth to a child.

words.ex: He pays a monthly subscription for the magazine.
words.ex_cn: 他每月支付杂志的订阅费。
words.en: A subscription is an amount of money that you pay regularly to receive a service or magazine, or to belong to or support an organization.

words.ex: He wrapped the candy in cellophane.
words.ex_cn: 他用玻璃纸包了糖果。
words.en: A thin, transparent sheet made of regenerated cellulose, used mainly as a wrapping material.

words.ex: She applied a soothing balm to the wound.
words.ex_cn: 她在伤口上涂了镇痛软膏。
words.en: A balm is a preparation that soothes, heals, or comforts, often applied to the skin.

words.ex: He is a man of great wit.
words.ex_cn: 他是个极具机智的人。
words.en: Wit is the ability to use words or ideas in a quick, clever, and amusing way.

words.ex: A white swan swam quietly on the lake.
words.ex_cn: 一只白天鹅静静地在湖上游泳。
words.en: A swan is a large, white bird with a long neck that lives on rivers and lakes.

words.tr: v. 塑造；定形；使成形；“shape”的现在分词；
words.ex: Parents are shaping their children's values.
words.ex_cn: 父母正在塑造孩子的价值观。
words.en: The act of giving a particular form or shape to something.

words.ex: The children walk along different paths to school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们走不同的路去上学。
words.en: Paths are routes or tracks between one place and another, often made by people walking.

words.tr: v. 租用；出租；租借； n. 租用；租用 v. 租用( rent的现在分词 )；
words.ex: He is renting a car for his trip.
words.ex_cn: 他正在为旅行租一辆车。
words.en: The act of paying for the use of something, such as a house, car, or piece of equipment, for a period of time.

words.ex: We had dinner, and afterwards we went for a walk.
words.ex_cn: 我们吃了晚饭，后来去散步了。
words.en: If you do something or if something happens afterwards, you do it or it happens after a particular event or time that has already been mentioned.

words.tr: adj. 先进的；高级的； v. 提前；前进；“advance”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: This school uses advanced technology in classrooms.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校在教室里使用先进的技术。
words.en: An advanced system, method, or design is modern and has been developed from an earlier version of the same thing.

words.ex: He is a freeman who owns his own land.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名自由民，拥有自己的土地。
words.en: A freeman is a person who is not a slave or serf and has the rights to own land and to engage in business.

words.tr: v. 挖掘；找到；“unearth”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The archaeologists unearthed an ancient pot.
words.ex_cn: 考古学家挖出了一件古代陶器。
words.en: If someone unearths facts or evidence, they discover them with difficulty, especially when they have been kept secret. If someone unearths something that is buried, they find it by digging in the ground.

words.ex: He attended a seminar on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他参加了一个关于气候变化的研讨会。
words.en: A seminar is a meeting where a group of people discuss a problem or topic.

words.tr:
n. 大学毕业生；
v. 毕业；
words.ex: He is a graduate of Harvard University.
words.ex_cn: 他是哈佛大学的毕业生。
words.en: A graduate is a person who has successfully completed a degree at a university or college and has received a certificate or diploma stating this. To graduate means to successfully complete a degree at a university or college.

words.ex: The plumber fixed the leaky pipe under the sink.
words.ex_cn: 水管工修好了水槽下漏水的管道。
words.en: A person who installs and repairs pipes, fittings, and fixtures for water supply and drainage.

words.tr: n. （尤指烟或蒸汽的）一阵；（脸上的）红晕；（糕点的）小圆饼
words.ex: The cat watches the puffs of smoke rise.
words.ex_cn: 猫看着烟雾一缕缕升起。
words.en: Small, light clouds of smoke or vapor.

words.tr:
adj. 被霜覆盖的；覆有糖霜的；（玻璃）磨砂的；毛面的
v. 在（糕饼）上撒糖霜
words.ex: The windows were frosted over with a thick layer of ice.
words.ex_cn: 窗户被一层厚厚的冰霜覆盖。
words.en: Covered with or as if with frost; having a dull or matte finish.

words.tr: adj. 关于花的；花饰的；过分华丽的；虚饰的
words.ex: Her speech was full of flowery phrases.
words.ex_cn: 她的演讲充满了华丽的辞藻。
words.en: Something that is flowery is full of elaborate or literary words and phrases.

words.ex: The picnic was an enjoyable day with friends.
words.ex_cn: 野餐是和朋友一起度过的愉快一天。
words.en: Something that is enjoyable gives you pleasure.

words.tr: adj. 必需的；基本的；本质的；
words.ex: Water is essential for life.
words.ex_cn: 水对生命是必需的。
words.en: Something that is essential is extremely important or absolutely necessary to a particular subject, situation, or activity.

words.tr: n. 气味；香味；香水 v. 嗅到；察觉
words.ex: The flowers give off sweet scents.
words.ex_cn: 这些花散发出甜美的香味。
words.en: Scents refer to pleasant smells, especially from flowers or perfume, or the ability to detect smells.

words.ex: The eucalyptus tree smells fresh.
words.ex_cn: 桉树闻起来很清新。
words.en: A tall evergreen tree native to Australia and cultivated elsewhere, valued for its wood, oil, and gum.

words.ex: Sugar dissolves in water.
words.ex_cn: 糖在水中溶解。
words.en: If a substance dissolves in liquid or if you dissolve a substance, it becomes mixed with the liquid and disappears.

words.ex: She steeped chamomile tea to help her relax.
words.ex_cn: 她泡了一杯甘菊茶来帮助自己放松。
words.en: Chamomile is a small white flower with a yellow centre, which is used to make tea and is also used in herbal medicine for its calming effects.

words.ex: He explores different realms of science.
words.ex_cn: 他探索科学的不同领域。
words.en: A realm is an area of activity, interest, or knowledge, or a country ruled by a king or queen.

words.ex: The soda begins to effervesce when you open it.
words.ex_cn: 当你打开汽水时，它开始冒泡。
words.en: If a liquid effervesces, it produces small bubbles of gas.

words.tr: adj. （女子外表、举止、穿着）男性化的，男人腔的；（男子）高大的; n. 充当男性角色的女同性恋...
words.ex: She wears short hair and suits, looking very butch.
words.ex_cn: 她留着短发，穿着西装，看起来非常男性化。
words.en: A butch person is someone, especially a woman, who behaves and dresses in a traditionally male way.

words.tr: v. 炖煮；烦恼；焦虑（stew 的现在分词形式）
words.ex: He is stewing soup on the stove.
words.ex_cn: 他正在炉子上炖汤。
words.en: Cooking slowly in liquid at a low temperature.

words.ex: The cuckoo sings loudly in the spring.
words.ex_cn: 杜鹃在春天大声鸣叫。
words.en: A cuckoo is a bird with a call that sounds like its name. It is known for laying its eggs in the nests of other birds.

words.tr: v. 重新排列；重新安排
words.ex: He rearranged the books on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 他把书架上的书重新排列了。
words.en: If you rearrange the objects in a place, you change the way in which they are organized or positioned.

words.tr: n. 礼貌得体；适宜的举止
words.ex: He maintained decorum during the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议期间保持了得体的行为。
words.en: Decorum is behavior that is controlled, calm, and polite, especially in formal situations.

words.ex: That was a humdinger of a storm!
words.ex_cn: 那是一场超级猛烈的风暴！
words.en: A humdinger is someone or something that is extremely impressive or outstanding.

words.ex: He speaks in a conversational tone with his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他和朋友说话时用会话式的语调。
words.en: Relating to or in the style of a conversation; informal and friendly.

words.ex: The president vetoes the new law.
words.ex_cn: 总统否决了这项新法律。
words.en: Officially rejects or forbids something, especially a law or proposal.

words.ex: He chose computer science as his major.
words.ex_cn: 他把计算机科学选为自己的专业。
words.en: Majors refer to the main subjects or fields of study that students choose to focus on in college or university.

words.tr: adj. 短暂的；瞬间的；刹那间的
words.ex: The light made a momentary flash.
words.ex_cn: 灯光闪了一下，但只持续了一瞬间。
words.en: lasting for a very short time

words.ex: The children were playing in the schoolyard during recess.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在课间休息时在校园里玩耍。
words.en: The area of land around a school where children can play.

words.ex: He is eighty years old.
words.ex_cn: 他八十岁了。
words.en: The number 80.

words.tr: n. 迪顿（美国地名，如俄亥俄州的Dayton）
words.ex: He lives in Dayton, Ohio.
words.ex_cn: 他住在俄亥俄州的代顿。
words.en: A city in Ohio, USA, known for its aviation history.

words.tr: n. 锯木匠；显赫天牛；漂流水中的树木; n. （Sawyer）人名；（英、葡）索耶
words.ex: He worked as a sawyer in the lumber mill.
words.ex_cn: 他在锯木厂当锯木匠。
words.en: A sawyer is a person who saws wood, especially as a job.

words.ex: We saw a giant sequoia in the national park.
words.ex_cn: 我们在国家公园里看到了一棵巨大的红杉。
words.en: A sequoia is a very tall evergreen tree that grows in California. It is one of the largest and oldest living things on Earth.

words.ex: The sheep graze on the heath.
words.ex_cn: 羊在荒地上吃草。
words.en: A heath is an area of open land covered with rough grass or heather and with very few trees or bushes.

words.ex: Water is a common solvent for salt.
words.ex_cn: 水是盐的常见溶剂。
words.en: A solvent is a substance that can dissolve other substances, or a person or company that has enough money to pay their debts.

words.ex: The city has many industrial factories.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市有许多工业工厂。
words.en: Industrial means relating to or characterized by industry.

words.ex: Farmers grow wheat in the field.
words.ex_cn: 农民在田里种植小麦。
words.en: Wheat is a cereal plant that is grown in temperate countries and is the most important kind grown for food.

words.ex: The potter fired the clay in a kiln.
words.ex_cn: 陶匠把陶土放在窑里烧制。
words.en: A kiln is a type of oven that is used to bake clay and pottery in order to make them hard.
